They plan to use the general to infiltrate and destroy a heavily guarded German ammunition depot to stop an upcoming attack. However, the general manages to attract the attention of a distant Nazi search party, and the Rat Patrol ends up trapped in a ravine, cut off by Capt. Dietrich's mobile squad. They construct a "fake panzer unit" of their own to escape, tricking the Germans into a retreat. They then make it to the largest of the Germans' ammo dumps and blow it.

episodes:2148.name: The Kill or Be Killed Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Using his fluent German, knowledge of Arabian lore, and disguised as a German officer, Sgt. Moffitt infiltrates Colonel Schweiger's headquarters to decipher and destroy an ancient map detailing a lost oasis deep in the desert with an ancient water source. Meanwhile, Sgt. Troy must overwatch the mission with orders to kill Sgt. Moffitt if he is discovered and captured. This is, of course, precisely what then happens. Troy faces the decision to kill his comrade and friend or find some way to disobey his orders and rescue the mission.

episodes:2148.name: The Chain of Death Raid
episodes:2148.summary: The Patrol captures a German truck at the end of a partially destroyed convoy. In the process, though, Troy and Dietrich end up alone in the desert - a stand-off until Arab slave traders arrive and capture both, hauling them deeper into the southern desert on the first leg of the slave trail. Troy and Dietrich escape but are chained together and must make their way back to "civilization" through the heat, the sand, and the enemy - both enemies. They agree after both are nearly dead from exposure to cooperate. The truce ends when they arrive at Dietrich's column, but before they get down to the convoy, Troy trips, and Dietrich becomes unconscious. Troy frees himself, and Dietrich is picked up by his people. Troy rejoins Hitch, who has been driving along at the end of the column. They reach an oasis, and Troy places the explosives, which was their mission in the first place. The oasis blows up, and the Rat Patrol escapes.

episodes:2148.name: The Do or Die Raid
episodes:2148.summary: A large Panzer unit has a map showing a strategic oasis occupied by the Eighth Armored Division. U.S. Intelligence wants the map exchanged for a phony one to show the oasis as empty, setting an ambush for the Panzers. Sgt. Griffin, a veteran map expert, accompanies Troy and his men into the German HQ. They enter the area at midnight, using bows and arrows for weapons, but Griffin has a heart attack picking the lock of a safe. The team is trapped in the commander's office. In the end, Troy bullies the "expert" into keeping up the effort until they complete the mission, after which Troy ends up endangering his own life to get Griffin out of the town.

episodes:2148.name: The Blind Man's Bluff Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Troy suffers a concussion from an explosion during a skirmish with the Germans. He ends up alone and lost in the desert. By the time he is found, he has a terrible case of sun blindness. Unknown to Troy, though, his "rescue" has been by a German unit pretending to be Americans, so they can coax Troy to tell him where the rest of the Rat Patrol is. Dietrich is the engineer behind this ploy. In the end, recovering from the sun blindness in the nick of time, Troy escapes.

episodes:2148.name: The Fatal Chase Raid
episodes:2148.summary: The Patrol manages to ambush a German unit carrying US POWs. Three of these POWs are apparently out to kill each other. Sgt. Gribs, whose cowardliness caused his men to become captured, is fighting against Tex and Eddie, two privates who want revenge. Gribs bargains with Troy for protection, telling Troy that he has information vital to US Command about Nazi troop movements. Gribs parcels out slight hints of his "vital" information to keep himself safe. They start back to HQ, but one of the unit's jeeps breaks down. They continue to travel slowly across the desert until they can capture a German vehicle. It all ends in heroism or something close.

episodes:2148.name: The Blow Sky High Raid
episodes:2148.summary: The Rat Patrol must destroy a very prized German radar station, clearing the way for an Allied bombing raid. The Rat Patrol receives a new, special kind of explosives to do it. Troy is apprehensive about carrying this dangerous cargo, which can explode with the slightest bump. Dietrich learns of the mission and tries to beat the Patrol to the area by utilizing an old Arabic legend of an unknown "trigh" (road) through the jebels (mountains). The Patrol is also in search of this trigh. But Moffitt gets them lost, and Dietrich beats them there. Troy then manages to plant some explosives -- and bluffs Dietrich out of the radar station by telling him that he's willing to die himself rather than let the station do its work.

episodes:2148.name: The Moment of Truce Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Fanatical Arabs, wanting to end the war on their land and rid it of all infidels, simultaneously attack the Rat Patrol and the German convoy led by Dietrich. Both units are trapped in a small desert ruin, forcing them into an uneasy truce. One of the Germans, a liaison to the Arabs, tries to talk Dietrich into betraying the Rat Patrol to the Arabs, but he refuses. Later, the liaison attempts to go over to the Arabs himself, but they kill him. Dietrich and Troy construct a trap of their own, killing many of the Arabs and escaping.

episodes:2148.name: The Deadly Double Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Moffitt and Tully allow themselves to be captured to get information from Craig -- an American POW -- about Rommel's new battle plans. However, Marston, another POW, tells them that Craig died. However, Dr. Phillips, the camp medic, supposedly has some information about the plan. When the doctor treats Moffitt's arm, he puts the code name of the mission on the underside of the bandage: Operation Nachtigall. However, it soon becomes evident that either Phillips or Marston is a traitor, and it is up to the Patrol to figure out which, as they are both now giving the Patrol conflicting information.

episodes:2148.name: The Gun Runner Raid
episodes:2148.summary: An Arab convoy, disguised as Americans, traps and captures the Rat Patrol. The convoy's leader, Ned Cunningham, is an embittered American airman and hero turned traitor and gunrunner. He is about to sell Deitrich captured American weapons and equipment. He now sells to the highest bidder from his lavish desert compound, no matter which side. Ned feels that the Rat Patrol is costing him too much business and plans to eliminate them. But he then decides he likes the Patrol and will take them into the deal as partners if they cooperate. In the end, though, his duplicitous behavior causes his own death.

episodes:2148.name: The Lighthouse Raid
episodes:2148.summary: The Rat Patrol undertakes an ambitious mission: They must rescue an ailing French Resistance general from a Nazi stronghold. Tully and Moffitt transport the liberated general to a rendezvous at a German-held lighthouse. Hitchcock stands lookout, disguised as a German guard. However, Troy is held captive inside the lighthouse, betrayed by the lighthouse keeper Mathias, who wants the reward the Germans will pay for the general. Moffitt tries to reach him but ends up unconscious. In the ensuing fight, Mathias dies, and Troy manages to signal a trawler into the area to smuggle the general to safety.

episodes:2148.name: The Dare-Devil Rescue Raid
episodes:2148.summary: German artillery traps 2000 Allied soldiers, and their only chance of rescue is an Allied armored attack. However, the necessary equipment can only reach them in time via an ancient Roman road now hidden by sand, a road only Moffitt's father can find. Moffitt's father's plane crashes enroute to its landing site. The Rat Patrol finds the burned-out plane and Moffitt's father missing. Moffitt wants to find him, but Troy insists their priority is to find the road themselves. Troy thinks the elder Moffitt must be dead, but Moffitt believes the Germans captured him. Moffitt escapes the team and rescues his father. The team saves them, and they find the road.

episodes:2148.name: The Last Harbor Raid (1)
episodes:2148.summary: After each Allied bombing of their harbor, the Germans use Allied POWs to rebuild it. HQ sends the Rat Patrol to liberate 5,000 POWs and halt the harbor's usefulness. Troy must coordinate his plans with Major Indrus, an American who is inside the camp. They use an explosive-laden boat to get into the harbor but the Germans stop it halfway in. The captain, Bertaine, doesn't allow the Germans to board his boat. Troy and his men are able to fight off the boarding party and escape into town but at the cost of Bertaine's life. They are followed by El Gamil, a sympathetic Arab merchant and black marketeer, who provides a car and uniforms for Moffitt and Hitchcock to go to the German Officer's Club in search of Bertaine's daughter Marianne. She is regarded as a traitor by locals because she performs at the club, but Troy has no choice but to seek out her help. The episode ends with Moffitt and Hitchcock entering the club.

episodes:2148.name: The Last Harbor Raid (2)
episodes:2148.summary: Moffitt and Hitch (dressed as Germans) find Bertaine's daughter Marianne, a suspected collaborator, singing at the German Officer's Club. After telling her of her father's death, they drive her home and inform her who they really are. They also tell her they must use the local fishing fleet to accomplish their mission. Meanwhile, Troy secretly meets with American POW liaison officer Major Indrus. Troy then joins Moffitt at the house of El Gamil. Informed of the plan, El Gamil dispatches his men to the various harbor areas to alert the fishermen. El Gamil and the Rat Patrol raid a German warehouse to regain their captured munitions to aid the escape, but the Germans catch and execute El Gamil. Troy sets the action to begin at dawn to evacuate 5,000 Allied POWS.

episodes:2148.name: The Last Harbor Raid (3)
episodes:2148.summary: The plan is for the fishing fleet to bring out the Allied POWs, Dunkirk-fashion. The fishermen believe that Marianne is a collaborator. Sgt. Troy, though, disagrees, and he's right. Marianne talks the fishermen into cooperating, and the prisoners make good their escape to freedom. Unfortunately, Marianne is killed in the evacuation.

episodes:2148.name: The One That Got Away Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Gustav Luden, a German radio operator who wants to defect, sends secret information on supply shipments to the Americans on a frequency that the Rat Patrol listens to. The Patrol goes in after him. They get inside the German base and, once there, find that the Gestapo have seized Luden for questioning.

episodes:2148.name: Two for One Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Valuable German ammunition has been dropped by parachute to an Arab farmhouse for a convoy to pick up, and the Rat Patrol must destroy it. On destroying the building, Troy discovers that there is no ammo--but there is a confused 16-year-old boy. The boy proves out to be the son of the German convoy commander. Even while the Rat's prisoner, the youth desperately tries to get word to the convoy so his father won't be killed. Troy is going to kill the commander, but when the boy pleads with him not to, Troy remembers what it felt like to lose his own father, who died when Troy was this boy's age. Troy captures the German instead of killing him. Then, the Rat Patrol destroys the convoy with the ammo.

episodes:2148.name: The Last Chance Raid
episodes:2148.summary: The Rat Patrol discovers German tank reinforcements have arrived in the area of a planned Allied offensive. But a German ambush wrecks the Patrol's radio, and Troy cannot warn HQ of the Nazi unit. Troy knows El Jebel has a large Nazi propaganda radio station and heads there. Troy, Moffitt, and the others make their way into the radio room and prepare to broadcast their warning to the British. However, Captain Deitrich walks in on them and takes them prisoner. Troy and Moffitt manage to escape. They free Hitch and Pettigrew and get their message back to London, preventing the Allies from losing a lot of tanks.

episodes:2148.name: The B Negative Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Moffitt gets seriously wounded during a raid on a German convoy with the Rat Patrol far behind enemy lines. So Troy decides to obtain blood from a nearby German field camp. Dietrich is in charge of the base; Troy encounters him and orders him to help him find a donor. Dietrich sends for Corporal Pennell, a captured American deserter. Pennell refuses to cooperate, but Troy takes him at gunpoint. On the way back to Moffitt, Dietrich catches up to them, and Pennell must do the "impossible" to prevent them from all being recaptured. He rises to the occasion, and they make it back to Moffitt and Tully in time to save Moffitt's life. As for Pennell's future, Troy will say the corporal was, unfortunately, separated from his unit by accident.

episodes:2148.name: The Exhibit A Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Troy and Hitchcock capture Col Beckmann, an infamous Nazi POW camp commander. Beckmann denies that he is the man. In a fight, Troy gets knocked out, and Hitch is wounded. Using Troy's gun, Beckmann kills the other German captured with him, exchanges dog tags with him, and places the pistol near Troy's hand. Thus, Troy gets falsely accused of the murder. Moffitt and Tully only arrive afterward. To prove to a court-martial board that Beckmann is Beckmann, the rest of the Rat Patrol must infiltrate a German division's headquarters to find the evidence to prevent Troy's court-martial--at considerable risk to their own lives.

episodes:2148.name: The Holy War Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Hauptmann Dietrich executes a plan to sway the Arab desert tribes to the German side by using a fake Rat Patrol to abduct their marabout or religious leader. He will then "rescue" the holy man so the Arabs will give their help to the Germans. The actual Patrol is captured by the Arabs, though, and when they convince the Arab leader, a friend of Moffitt's, that they aren't guilty, Troy and Moffitt go to find the holy man. To do so means a horse trip across the desert.

episodes:2148.name: The Two Against Time Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Using a telephoto lens, Moffitt and Troy photograph a map inside Captain Dietrich's office from the roof of the adjoining Nazi HQ. It shows the location of a top-secret German ammo dump. The Patrol must reach the site, enter it, and destroy it before half of the German army arrives. The Patrol arrives to find the storage area--an old mine--surprisingly deserted. They plant the explosives, but just before they blow it, Dietrich (who has laid this all out as a trap) turns up. Shots are exchanged, and Dietrich and Troy are trapped inside. Meantime, outside the mine, assuming that the cave-in killed Troy, Moffitt and the Patrol prepare to finish blowing it up. Working together, Troy and Dietrich escape through a back entrance moments before the dump blows.

episodes:2148.name: The Wild Goose Raid
episodes:2148.summary: The British and the American high command scheduled a top-secret conference in a desert town. On the day before the event, the Rat Patrol sights a German motorcyclist and chases him, but he gets away. Assuming that the Nazis know about the conference, Troy tries to talk the commanders out of the meeting. But instead, they assign him to be in charge of the security. Troy gets jumped while in town by a knife-wielding Arab. Sgt Roberts, one of the other "security" men, rescues Troy. Unknown to them, Roberts is a double agent planning to blow up the meeting--a fact that Troy learns.

episodes:2148.name: The Bring 'Em Back Alive Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Troy raids German HQ and kidnaps Dr. Schneidermann, a prominent Nazi scientist. At the same time, Captain Dietrich captures Moffitt, Pettigrew, and Hitchcock. Dietrich reveals that Troy is carrying a vial of deadly radium. He urges Moffitt to divulge Troy's destination, bargaining the Rat Patrols' unconditional freedom for the return of Schneidermann. Moffitt, disbelieving the radium story, keeps quiet. However, Troy is carrying the fatal vessel. The three Patrollers escape and trail Troy back to the rendezvous, with Dietrich trailing them.

episodes:2148.name: Take Me to Your Leader Raid
episodes:2148.summary: The Rat Patrol stumbles on a German staff car, but before they can attack it, a soldier (apparently an American major) kills the driver and a guard. This Major Lansing claims the Germans captured him en route to divisional headquarters. He orders the Patrol to take him there for a secret high-level meeting. They do so, unaware that he is a German officer and Dietrich is trailing them. After he arrives at headquarters, he is to assassinate an Allied general. On the way, however, they stumble on a unit of severely injured Italians. Their officer returns with the Patrol to get his men some help and recognizes that the Major must be German. After which, the German attempts to kill the Italian arousing Troy's suspicion.

episodes:2148.name: The Double or Nothing Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Moffitt is about to be executed for "espionage against the Third Reich" when suddenly the Rat Patrol comes to his rescue. A commandeered German truck unsuccessfully attempts to scoop up Moffitt but manages to take a Nazi captain in his place for exchange. Negotiations for a prisoner exchange are fruitful, but Troy doubts that the Germans will obey their own rules. Indeed, the Nazi's Colonel Voss wants to see the Patrol wiped out and uses the exchange as a trap. The captured captain tries to escape the Patrol and gets himself killed. Now Troy has no one to exchange for a seriously wounded Moffitt and must attempt to pass himself off as a German.

episodes:2148.name: The Hour Glass Raid
episodes:2148.summary: After capturing Dr. Anderson, a skilled Allied physician, Dietrich turns over his staff car in a ravine (during a blinding sand storm). Troy wants to attempt to rescue the doctor but can't because of the storm. He hears Dietrich's distress call but suspects it is a trick. Ultimately, they try as they hear that the Germans will do the same. They get Dr. Anderson, who is unhurt, but Dietrich is trapped under the car and badly injured. The doctor tells them that Dietrich is dead, but the German groans just before the Patrol leaves. When Troy ends up saving Dietrich's life, the doctor is about to kill him with a lethal dose of morphine. Dietrich tells Troy that Anderson is a double agent who gets killed just as the Germans arrive to help their captain.

episodes:2148.name: Mask-a-Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Lieutenant Klinger, a wounded Luftwaffe ace, is the only German who can identify the location of the Allied troops preparing to invade Sicily. The Rat Patrol captures him, and then Moffitt takes his place to convince the Germans to watch the wrong place for the upcoming attack. Troy, meanwhile, infiltrates the military hospital. Gestapo Major Bruder, however, suspects Moffitt and exposes him, but by the time he does, Moffitt manages to get Bruder killed in his place and escape.

episodes:2148.name: The Fire and Brimstone Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Troy and his men plant explosives with 3-minute fuses in an Arab winery the Germans use as an ammo depot. While trying for a hasty getaway, they run into Dietrich, who orders them to surrender. Knowing they are safely surrounded by explosives, Troy and Moffitt defuse the charges and wait for nightfall to escape. Not wanting to blow the depot sky high, Dietrich's men use bows and arrows and shoot Hitch in the shoulder. The two Germans are quickly taken care of by Troy. Moffitt uses smoke grenades and tries to reach a truck, but Dietrich captures him. With the help of the Arab winery owner, the Rat Patrol finally dashes to safety. When the American grenade fails to blow up the ammo depot, the winery owner does it for them.

episodes:2148.name: The Delilah Raid
episodes:2148.summary: A young French Resistance fighter named Michele survives the Patrol's quick assault on a small German convoy. She explains Germans captured her during her group's attempt to stop the convoy carrying radar equipment. However, Michele is a double agent and will deliver the Patrol to her lover, German Colonel Leske. She convinces the Patrol to accompany her on a raid to destroy a German radar base. Leske captures the Rat Patrol, but he gets killed, saving Michele during their escape while blowing up the radar base.

episodes:2148.name: The Truce at Aburah Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Captain Dietrich monitors a broadcast to the Patrol from HQ and then intercepts them on their way to meet and escort a supply convoy. With the odds decidedly against the Rats, Troy takes refuge in an oasis. A young Arab girl playing nearby runs away, terrified of the noise, and falls down an old well. The Rat Patrol and Dietrich's unit agree to a truce and work together to save the child, who is still alive. But the arrival of a second German unit complicates the reluctant peace, shooting Tully. Ultimately, they rescue the child, and the Patrol escapes in the confusion.

episodes:2148.name: The David and Goliath Raid
episodes:2148.summary: The Rat Patrol ambushes a German courier and finds charts in his papers of desert waterholes and oases unknown to the Allies or the Germans. Suddenly Captain Deitrich's patrol attacks, wounding Tully and destroying the Patrol's jeeps, water and weapons. Troy and the crew strike out for a waterhole mentioned on the chart. Hours later, near their end, Troy and his men stagger toward an inviting waterhole only to find it poisoned. On a distant dune, they see Dietrich. Tully is near the end because of his wound. Dietrich offers to accept Troy's surrender. The Rat Patrol's only chance for survival is infiltrating Dietrich's encampment and stealing a vehicle.

episodes:2148.name: The Trial by Fire Raid
episodes:2148.summary: The Patrol attempts to destroy supplies in a small village where the Germans are loading a train with ammunition. However, the Germans are using a small group of Arabs (including women and children) to load the ammunition. One of the women stumbles upon Troy and offers to help by warning her people. But as Troy attempts to plant the explosives, Dietrich catches on to the plan and gives an alarm. Troy ends up shot and captured. It is now up to the rest of the Patrol to cause enough diversion to get him free. The woman continues to plead with Dietrich to give Troy medical attention. As Dietrich is questioning Troy, though, Troy breaks free, shoots the German, and can get the explosives planted with the Arab woman's father's help. The train goes up, but the father dies.

episodes:2148.name: The Darers Go First Raid
episodes:2148.summary: A heavily guarded German fortress appears impervious to the Rat Patrol's efforts to destroy its big supply depot. So, Troy determines their only chance to blow the depot is to capture a German tank and use it to get past the guards.

episodes:2148.name: The Love Thine Enemy Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Troy accidentally wounds a German nurse when the Patrol ambushes an Afrika Korps supply column. She is the lone survivor and requires urgent medical attention. The team faces the choice of completing their mission or allowing the girl to die. A guilt-stricken Troy desperately decides to take her to a nearby German field hospital. The only problem is that on the way, she overhears a piece of vital information.

episodes:2148.name: The Darkest Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Capt. Richter must convey a large cache of "confiscated" diamonds to Berlin to finance the Nazi desert campaign. The Rat Patrol must steal the diamonds from a military HQ in the desert. But, brute force will not succeed, so they need to attempt a plan full of guile and cunning to pull the theft off. So, Troy infiltrates the German H.Q., posing as a blinded Afrika Korps officer.

episodes:2148.name: The Death Do Us Part Raid
episodes:2148.summary: En route to a meeting with an unknown Arab agent, Dietrich ambushes the patrol wounding Troy. Except for Troy, they're all captured and taken to Dietrich's desert base. Troy eventually meets up with the agent, who turns out to be a teenage boy, and a female Irish teacher, but will she allow the boy to help Troy?

episodes:2148.name: The Do-Re-Mi Raid
episodes:2148.summary: The Patrol's orders are to rescue famous American pop star Mickey Roberts captured by Dietrich. The singer is a P.O.W. in a small Afrika Korps compound, and the S.S. arrives to turn Roberts into a propaganda coup. Troy lets himself be captured to free Roberts.

episodes:2148.name: The Kingdom Come Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Hitchcock supervises a special mission to deliver secret new anti-aircraft shell fuses when a German unit attacks the transport convoy. An American deserter wounds Hitchcock during the attack.

episodes:2148.name: The Hide-and-Go-Seek Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Dietrich leads a German commando raid to kidnap the 13-year-old mute son of British General Simms and take him to the Island of Rhodes. A German colonel holds the boy hostage to trade him for his father. The Rat Patrol must rescue the boy from the island's garrison with only the help of one Greek resistance fighter.

episodes:2148.name: The Violent Truce Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Moffitt takes over a mission to warn a British convoy of the contaminated plasma they are carrying.

episodes:2148.name: The Life for a Life Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Dietrich corners the Rat Patrol in a cellar with a pregnant Arab woman who has a valuable map and a French resistance fighter who has a personal vendetta against her over his wife's death.

episodes:2148.name: The Fifth Wheel Raid
episodes:2148.summary: The Germans capture a British colonel under suspicious circumstances as he returns from a staff meeting regarding an upcoming Allied offensive. The Rat Patrol receives orders to either rescue or kill him before the Germans interrogate him. His Sikh aide insists on participating in the mission.

episodes:2148.name: The Two If by Sea Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Moffitt infiltrates a German-held lighthouse posing as an electrician to learn the details of a German naval convoy carrying Tiger tanks headed for North Africa.

episodes:2148.name: The Street Urchin Raid
episodes:2148.summary: An Arab street kid is pursued by both the Rats and the Nazis when he gets hold of photos of secret German installations.

episodes:2148.name: The Pipeline to Disaster Raid
episodes:2148.summary: General Owen Lansbury, the head of British Intelligence in the Near East, bails out of his damaged plane behind enemy lines. After his rescue in the desert, he insists upon leading the Rat Patrol on a mission to disrupt a German oil pipeline, despite his deteriorated condition. The Rats contemplate mutiny when the injured and delirious general tries to take control of the team.

episodes:2148.name: The Boomerang Raid
episodes:2148.summary: A Nazi soldier posing as an Allied contact who carries a critical map attracts Troy's attention by his reluctance to ambush some German soldiers.

episodes:2148.name: The Fatal Reunion Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Moffitt runs into an old girlfriend, now a French Resistance fighter. She joins the Rat Patrol on a mission to rescue a French space scientist.

episodes:2148.name: The Decoy Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Sadistic SS Captain Wansee arrests the Swiss Red Cross worker Miss Arno vaccinating a North African village threatened by typhus. This mentally unstable SS officer breaks a truce in an attempt to capture the Rat Patrol, but Dietrich intervenes

episodes:2148.name: The Touch-and-Go Raid
episodes:2148.summary: The Rat Patrol falls prey to a clever Nazi scheme when they rush to aid a band of trapped Allied soldiers, who are really Dietrich's soldiers. Taking a page out of Troy's playbook, Dietrich and three of his men pose as the Rat Patrol to infiltrate an Allied supply depot.

episodes:2148.name: The Field of Death Raid
episodes:2148.summary: A German colonel, crippled in an earlier raid by the Rat Patrol, captures Troy's brother, an RAF pilot, in a plan for revenge to trap and destroy them.

episodes:2148.name: The Double Jeopardy Raid
episodes:2148.summary: The arrival of a team of teenage guerrilla fighters spells "double-trouble" for the Patrol. The embittered young partisans, led by a 17-year-old Jean-Claude with his fiery girlfriend Monique, are determined to do things their way in an unplanned raid in an impenetrable S.S. camp, even though this means putting the Patrol temporarily out of action.

episodes:2148.name: The Hickory, Dickory Dock Raid
episodes:2148.summary: The Rat Patrol is assigned a mission to safeguard POWs being held at a German repair depot that bombers will target. On the eve of the mission, Moffitt receives word that a German bomb killed his younger brother in London. Rage consumes Moffitt making him unreliable and endangering the mission to avenge his brother.

episodes:2148.name: The Tug-of-War Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Troy goes undercover to receive a locket of microfilm from a female French Resistance fighter. But before both are captured, he hurriedly disposes of the microfilm in an open grave. After Troy refuses to divulge the location of the locket, Dietrich sentences them both to hang--and Troy must find a way to get word to the Rat Patrol for rescue.

episodes:2148.name: The Never Say Die Raid
episodes:2148.summary: Troy and Hitchcock are captured by a German colonel with a scheme for them to radio false information back to their headquarters. Meanwhile, an Italian officer who wants to surrender to Moffitt and Pettigrew complicates rescue attempts. The Italian officer's sense of humor helps facilitate the escape of two Rats.

episodes:2148.name: The Kill at Koorlea Raid
episodes:2148.summary: The appalling brutality of a Nazi general makes him a prime target for an Allied offensive. The Rat Patrol is ordered to go with a South African sniper on a mission to kill the German general, but Troy decides to try to capture the general alive.

show:tremors.name: Tremors
show:tremors.summary: In this sequel to the theatrical and direct-to-video movies, the desert town of Perfection, Nevada, is under government protection because of the endangered species known as Graboids: large earth-burrowing worm-like creatures. Most of the residents of Perfection have refused to move, and now they have to cope with the Graboids and their variations, government agents, real-estate developers, other experiments from the same scientists who created the Graboids, and more.

episodes:4208.name: Feeding Frenzy
episodes:4208.summary: Tyler Reed moves to Perfection, Nevada, the home of a giant prehistoric worm and a world-renowned monster hunter.

episodes:4208.name: Ghost Dance
episodes:4208.summary: Burt and his old friend Cletus try to help the government put a stop to a deadly menace that's literally sucking the life out of visitors to Perfection.

episodes:4208.name: Night of the Shriekers
episodes:4208.summary: Government scientists test an experiment in Perfection.

episodes:4208.name: Blast from the Past
episodes:4208.summary: When a hang-glider mysteriously arrives in town, the people of Perfection become reacquainted with an old foe.

episodes:4208.name: Flora or Fauna
episodes:4208.summary: The "Mix-master" creates a deadly mutation that is part plant, part animal.

episodes:4208.name: Hit and Run
episodes:4208.summary: Two small-time Vegas mobsters travel to Perfection to lay low and take in the El Blanco show.

episodes:4208.name: A Little Paranoia Among Friends
episodes:4208.summary: While investigating a Graboid sighting in Toluca, Burt tries to reason with the paranoid townspeople.

episodes:4208.name: Project 4-12
episodes:4208.summary: Tyler tells Larry Norvel the story of Dr. Cletus Poffenberger when he first arrived in Perfection Valley with his dangerous pet, 4-12.

episodes:4208.name: Graboid Rights
episodes:4208.summary: Publicity-hungry environmentalists bent on "protecting" El Blanco from Burt and the townsfolk invade Perfection.

episodes:4208.name: The Sounds of Silence
episodes:4208.summary: Science-fiction fan Larry Norvel moves to Perfection just in time to witness an invasion by a horde of flesh-eating insects.

episodes:4208.name: The Key
episodes:4208.summary: Frank the Las Vegas thug returns to Perfection with his cold-blooded girlfriend to retrieve the lockbox key swallowed by El Blanco.

episodes:4208.name: Water Hazard
episodes:4208.summary: Tyler and Rosalita go into business with the unscrupulous Melvin Plug; a deadly new creature emerges outside the valley.

episodes:4208.name: Shriek & Destroy
episodes:4208.summary: The government enlists Burt and Tyler to rid Juniper, Arizona, of an infestation of deadly Shriekers that reproduce by eating.

show:altered.name: Altered Carbon
show:altered.summary: Altered Carbon is set in the 25th century when the human mind has been digitized and the soul itself is transferable from one body to the next. Takeshi Kovacs, a former elite interstellar warrior known as an Envoy who has been imprisoned for 250 years, is downloaded into a future he'd tried to stop. If he can solve a single murder in a world where technology has made death nearly obsolete, he'll get a chance at a new life on Earth.

episodes:12036.name: Out of the Past
episodes:12036.summary: Waking up in a new body 250 years after his death, Takeshi Kovacs discovers he's been resurrected to help a titan of industry solve his own murder.

episodes:12036.name: Fallen Angel
episodes:12036.summary: While Kovacs tracks down a man who sent Bancroft a death threat, Lt. Ortega bends the rules to keep tabs on his whereabouts.

episodes:12036.name: In a Lonely Place
episodes:12036.summary: Kovacs recruits an unlikely partner to watch his back during a banquet at the Bancroft home, where Ortega oversees the night's grisly entertainment.

episodes:12036.name: Force of Evil
episodes:12036.summary: Tortured by his captor, Kovacs taps into his Envoy training to survive. Ortega springs a surprise on her family for Dia de los Muertos.

episodes:12036.name: The Wrong Man
episodes:12036.summary: After learning his sleeve's identity, Kovacs demands the full story from Ortega. A tip from Poe leads to a major breakthrough in the Bancroft case.

episodes:12036.name: Man with My Face
episodes:12036.summary: With Orgeta's fate hanging in the balance, Kovacs drops a bombshell on the Bancrofts. Later, he comes face to face with an unsettling opponent.

episodes:12036.name: Nora Inu
episodes:12036.summary: As Kovacs reconnects with a figure from his past, his tangled history with the Protectorate, the Uprising and Quell plays out in flashbacks.

episodes:12036.name: Clash by Night
episodes:12036.summary: His world rocked, Kovacs requests a dipper to help him sew up the Bancroft case quickly. Ortega races to identify the mystery woman from Fight Drome.

episodes:12036.name: Rage in Heaven
episodes:12036.summary: After a devastating rampage, Kovacs and his allies hatch a bold -- and very risky -- scheme to infiltrate Head in the Clouds.

episodes:12036.name: The Killers
episodes:12036.summary: As a cornered Kovacs braces for a final showdown in the sky, a new hero emerges and more buried secrets come to light.

episodes:12036.name: Phantom Lady
episodes:12036.summary: Thirty years after the Bancroft case, a Meth tracks down Kovacs to offer him a job, a high-tech sleeve and a chance to see Quellcrist Falconer again.

episodes:12036.name: Payment Deferred
episodes:12036.summary: As Col. Carrera takes charge of the murder investigation, Kovacs sets out to find Axley's bounty hunter, and Poe's memory glitches worsen.

episodes:12036.name: Nightmare Alley
episodes:12036.summary: Kovacs contends with ghosts from his past as he's tortured by Carrera. Poe seeks help from a fellow AI. Trepp gets a lead on the man she's after.

episodes:12036.name: Shadow of a Doubt
episodes:12036.summary: While the planet celebrates Harlan's Day, Kovacs hatches an escape plan, Quell pieces together fragments of her life, and Poe faces a reckoning.

episodes:12036.name: I Wake Up Screaming
episodes:12036.summary: Carrera sends his secret weapon on a deadly mission. Kovacs and Trepp smuggle Quell out of the city. Poe takes a risky trip into virtual reality.

episodes:12036.name: Bury Me Dead
episodes:12036.summary: As Quell reconnects to her past at Stronghold, she leads the clone into an underground chamber teeming with secrets. Gov. Harlan shows her true colors.

episodes:12036.name: Experiment Perilous
episodes:12036.summary: When Quell's sleeve begins to shut down, Poe and Ms. Dig send her into VR, where Kovacs finally learns the truth about her deadly rampages.

episodes:12036.name: Broken Angels
episodes:12036.summary: With the fate of the whole planet on the line, Kovacs, Quell and team race to find Konrad Harlan and stop a catastrophic blast of Angelfire.

show:animal.name: Animal
show:animal.summary: One minute he's elbow-deep in a pregnant cow; the next, he's wading through designer pet collars and expensive kibble. That's life for cranky vet Antón!

episodes:86556.name: Familia Kawanda
episodes:86556.summary: As the bills pile up and his farmer neighbors start paying him in eggs, Antón swallows his pride and considers a job at his niece's fancy pet store.

episodes:86556.name: Sonrisa llama a sonrisa
episodes:86556.summary: Grumpy Antón and upbeat Uxía's clashing personalities cause tension at home and work. After a run of bad reviews, Antón rethinks his customer service.

episodes:86556.name: Frases de taza
episodes:86556.summary: Furious that his old neighbors have found a new vet, Antón abandons Kawanda to prove his replacement a fraud — on the eve of a major poodle contest.

episodes:86556.name: Una ansiedad de cobaya
episodes:86556.summary: Antón grapples with anxiety — which isn't helped by corrupt farmers, strained relations with Sabela, Uxía's new boyfriend… or a pregnant guinea pig.

episodes:86556.name: Fundación Kawanda
episodes:86556.summary: Tired of life at Kawanda, Antón considers changing his moral stance to return to farm life — but first he must convince Nuno to replace him.

episodes:86556.name: El último paseo
episodes:86556.summary: Antón panics over the potential fallout from his work for the Andrades. As Uxía's ex attempts to patch things up, Nuno makes a startling announcement.

episodes:86556.name: La visita
episodes:86556.summary: Kawanda gets an inspection from the corporate headquarters. Antón's anxiety builds as he learns the authorities are investigating the Andrades' business.

episodes:86556.name: Las cataratas del Niágara
episodes:86556.summary: When the Andrades need his skills to save a seriously sick cow, Antón gets a chance at redemption in the eyes of Uxía, Sabela — and himself.

episodes:86556.name: Un día de perros
episodes:86556.summary: Antón finds himself in front of a judge. Uxía learns head office has plans to replace her. An outbreak of doggy stomach flu takes over Kawanda.

show:beneath.name: What Lies Beneath
show:beneath.summary: ID takes the real-footage murder genre to the next level with What Lies Beneath. In addition to real footage--CCTV, police interrogations, and home videos--included is completely new: gripping footage from inside the courtroom of the murder trial. What Lies Beneath uses the courtroom footage as tantalizing flash-forwards to tease the audience with key clues as each story unfolds, keeping viewers guessing until the end about the testimony: is it truth or lies? Is the person speaking a witness or a killer?

episodes:38640.name: Blood on the Tracks
episodes:38640.summary: After a body is discovered in Silver Lakes, CA, detectives work to piece a difficult puzzle together. They uncover a web of lies that unveils a sordid tale of betrayal. At trial the truth finally emerges and the identity of the killer is revealed.

episodes:38640.name: In Cold Blood
episodes:38640.summary: A family mysteriously goes missing from their home in Hudson, FL, and loved ones fear the worst. Following a frantic search the family are found, but not all are alive. Courtroom testimony from the trial reveals the chilling details of what ensued.

episodes:38640.name: Blood Creek
episodes:38640.summary: A teenage body found on school property panics a Kentucky town; but as investigators find themselves facing a wall of lies and false confessions that spans two states; will they ever locate the killer's true identity?

episodes:38640.name: Killer Disguise
episodes:38640.summary: A family man from a quiet community near the Mojave Desert is gunned down in cold blood. As his family mourn, police find no witnesses to the crime. But as detectives dig deeper, shocking secrets are exposed and the true killer is revealed.

episodes:38640.name: Dead Before Sunrise
episodes:38640.summary: The death of a prominent charity fundraiser leaves a tiny Kentucky community reeling. Investigators find themselves brushing shoulders with criminal biker gangs in pursuit of the killer and discover a twisted motive that shocks everyone.

episodes:38640.name: The Devil You Know
episodes:38640.summary: A mother and her two young children disappear from their home in Florida, family and friends are at a loss. Two suspects and each accuses the other. The family is never found. A neighbor's shocking revelation will unravel this appalling crime.

episodes:38640.name: Blood Jungle
episodes:38640.summary: In Maui, a mother reports her pregnant daughter missing to police. As the island launches mass searches into the jungle, the discoveries get more horrifying and the lies more complex. The trial takes months as the evil behind this tragedy is exposed.

show:cry wolf.name: Cry Wolf
show:cry wolf.summary: A psychological family thriller about a social worker and a mother who are thrust into crisis when the mother's teenage daughter alleges abuse, pushing both women to their limits as they navigate an impossible situation.

show:the darkness.name: The Darkness
show:the darkness.summary: Detective Inspector Hulda Hermannsdóttir is given a shocking new murder case whilst having to work with a new partner, and being in the cusp of early retirement.

episodes:80536.name: The Mountain of Pigs
episodes:80536.summary: Hulda is faced with the case of a missing woman that consumes her completely.

episodes:80536.name: Hello Old Friend
episodes:80536.summary: Hulda and Lukas delve into the complex and corrupt world of refugees in Iceland.

episodes:80536.name: Beautiful Girls
episodes:80536.summary: When another victim goes missing, Hulda and Lukas must uncover the connection between the cases.

episodes:80536.name: Through Me the Way Into the Suffering City
episodes:80536.summary: While investigating the case of the two missing women, Hulda discovers what lies behind Dimma's death.

episodes:80536.name: All That Is Hidden
episodes:80536.summary: Lukas and Hulda's investigation progresses as they delve into political and legal corruption.

episodes:80536.name: So Eden Sank to Grief
episodes:80536.summary: After discovering who killed Katja and kidnapped Elena, Hulda finds herself trapped with the killer.

show:dead in the water.name: Dead in the Water
show:dead in the water.summary: A young British couple's dream trip through remote Central America, turns into a chilling nightmare when they are brutally murdered and the trail for their killer goes cold. Four decades later, failed by law enforcement, their family take up the manhunt and make a shocking discovery.

episodes:76042.name: Episode 1
episodes:76042.summary: 1978. 25-year-old childhood sweethearts Chris Farmer and Peta Frampton are travelling through Central America sending tapes and letters home with details of their travels. A chance encounter with an American skipper and his two sons changes their plans and the nightmare back home, begins.

episodes:76042.name: Episode 2
episodes:76042.summary: Chris and Peta's bodies have been found floating off the coast of Guatemala. The killer is on the loose, and a key witness, fights to be heard. The case goes cold for four decades until, Chris' sister Penny turns online sleuth and discovers a truth much darker than they'd ever imagined.

episodes:76042.name: Episode 3
episodes:76042.summary: 2016. With the suspected killer in custody, Prosecution and Defense prepare for an epic courtroom battle that hinges on the credibility of the key witness. Justice is within reach when both families are dealt a cruel blow and are forced to face another agonising twist in a long journey for answers.

show:delirium.name: Delirium
show:delirium.summary: Set in a world where love is deemed illegal and can be eradicated with a special procedure. With 95 days to go until her scheduled treatment, Lena Holoway does the unthinkable, she falls in love.

show:the forest.name: The Forest
show:the forest.summary: Series revealing the hidden world of Galloway Forest, the country's largest afforested area.

episodes:34358.name: Episode 1
episodes:34358.summary: In this episode, the Forestry Commission's recreation team is tasked with rebuilding steps on a well-worn pathway at Fairy Knowe, but the steps are up a 330-foot hill. Getting hunks of granite rock to the remote hill is one problem and digging them in by hand is another. A team of specialist contractors from Wales arrive in Galloway Forest to harvest timber from the most inaccessible areas using a massive system of cables and winches called the skyline. Deep in the forest, conservationists Bill and Christine breed and hand rear hyacinth macaws, the world's largest flying parrot. And on a remote peatbog the size of 32 football pitches, Graeme Little operates his own customised mulching machine.

episodes:34358.name: Episode 2
episodes:34358.summary: In this episode, James Jones sawmill in Lockerbie powers through 20,000 logs a day. But when a six-tonne machine called a crosscut stacker breaks down, a dedicated engineering team must save the day. A decline in salmon numbers in the River Cree near Newton Stewart has led to a tireless effort to restock the river by the Cree Hatchery and Habitat Trust. Archie McNeillie and John Coughtrie from the Forestry Commission's Recreation Department deal with a rat infestation in a public area caused by an overzealous bird feeder. And at Balloch O'Dee campsite, owner James gets ready to stage a comedy night.

episodes:34358.name: Episode 3
episodes:34358.summary: In this episode, Planning and Environment forester Bill Fisher surveys the vast forest and checks the health of the cash crop in a helicopter, where the bird's-eye view allows him to better spot any pockets of larch disease. Forestry Commission recreation boss Archie McNeillie attempts to balance the needs of the public with the needs of the timber industry by spray-painting some trees as a marker to the harvesters to save them so the public can still enjoy the scenic views. And Environment forester Gareth Ventress hires some traditional horse loggers to carry out a method called horse rolling in an area of dense bracken. Crushing the bracken using a horse is less damaging to the soil and allows light and space for oak saplings and native herbs and flowers to flourish.

episodes:34358.name: Episode 4
episodes:34358.summary: This episode follows three truckers as they track down, load and ferry timber to mills in the UK.

episodes:34358.name: Episode 5
episodes:34358.summary: Community liaison forester Lyndy Renwick must decide the fate of huts discovered on Forestry Commission land.

episodes:34358.name: Episode 6
episodes:34358.summary: John Coughtrie and Archie McNeillie prepare safe standing places for the crowds at the Galloway Hills Rally.

show:games.name: Sacred Games
show:games.summary: Set in Mumbai, Sacred Games delves into the city's intricate web of organized crime, corruption, politics and espionage that lie beneath India's economic renaissance. It is an epic masterwork of exceptional richness and power that interweaves the lives of the privileged, the famous, the wretched and the bloodthirsty.

episodes:18197.name: Aswatthama
episodes:18197.summary: A mysterious phone call from an anonymous man leads police officer Sartaj Singh on a chase around Mumbai in a dangerous cat-and-mouse game.

episodes:18197.name: Halahala
episodes:18197.summary: News of Ganesh Gaitonde creates a stir among Mumbai's VIPs, from politicians to film stars. Removed from the case, Sartaj begins his own investigation.

episodes:18197.name: Aatapi Vatapi
episodes:18197.summary: The woman found in the bunker leads Sartaj to Gaitonde's thug, Bunty. In a flashback, Gaitonde recalls stealing a lucky charm from rival Suleiman Isa.

episodes:18197.name: Brahmahatya
episodes:18197.summary: TV Starlet Nayanika visits Bunty with a hidden camera. In the mid-'80s, Gaitonde discovers a racket even more lucrative than drugs and guns: politics.

episodes:18197.name: Sarama
episodes:18197.summary: To save Nayanika, Sartaj intervenes during a RAW operation, In 1992, as political unrest increases, so does the bloodshed from Gaitonde and Isa's fued.

episodes:18197.name: Pretakalps
episodes:18197.summary: When Sartaj's constable, Katekar, is pressured to investigate the disappearance of a young man from a Muslim slum, disastrous consequences follow.

episodes:18197.name: Rudra
episodes:18197.summary: Hoping to tie up the many loose ends of their case, Sartaj and Anjali reunite to figure out how the enigmatic Trivedi is linked to Gatonde's prophecy.

episodes:18197.name: Yayati
episodes:18197.summary: To save Mumbai from impending doom, Sartaj races against time to find out who Gaitonde's third father is and what's planned to happen on the 25th day.

episodes:18197.name: Matsya
episodes:18197.summary: After making a discovery in Gaitonde's bunker, Sartaj joins a mission to foil a deadly conspiracy. In 1994, Gaitonde resurfaces in a new location.

episodes:18197.name: Siduri
episodes:18197.summary: With the terrorist-cell investigation underway, Sartaj visits Guruji's ashram. In the late '90s, Gaitonde is urged to seek a spiritual anchor.

episodes:18197.name: Apasmara
episodes:18197.summary: Sartaj traces how Shahid Khan's nuclear consignment was delivered to India. In the early 2000s, Gaitonde takes bold action to maintain his notoriety.

episodes:18197.name: Bardo
episodes:18197.summary: Sartaj's team tries to reach Shahid Khan via an internet chatroom. In 2003, Gaitonde's growing disenchantment with his life brings him closer to Guruji.

episodes:18197.name: Vikarna
episodes:18197.summary: As Sartaj's team baits a trap for Shahid Khan, Majid suspects a department member. Immersed in ashram life, Gaitonde learns of Guruji's lethal plans.

episodes:18197.name: Azrael
episodes:18197.summary: Batya lets Sartaj in on several secrets, leaving him reeling and conflicted. Gaitonde returns to Mumbai to set Guruji's destructive plan in motion.

episodes:18197.name: Torino
episodes:18197.summary: After committing a drastic act, Gaitonde can't silence Guruji's voice in his mind. Parulkar reaches a shocking realization. Sartaj makes a breakthrough.

episodes:18197.name: Radcliffe
episodes:18197.summary: Unsettling truths, complex betrayals and unforeseen connections emerge for Sartaj, Gaitonde and Shahid Khan as doomsday descends on Mumbai.

show:gone.name: Gone
show:gone.summary:
Set against the backdrop of a prestigious private school, a foreboding forest and the quiet sprawl of Bristol, Gone, is a chilling mystery focusing on local Headmaster Michael Polly who becomes the prime suspect in his wife Sarah's disappearance.

An upstanding member of the community, Michael Polly is inscrutable and likes order and precision in his working life. Until, that is, he encounters super bright, gutsy Detective Annie Cassidy and a compulsive game of cat and mouse begins as she chips away at his veneer in search of the truth.

episodes:88579.name: Episode 1
episodes:88579.summary: Headmaster Michael Polly arrives home with his daughter, Alana, to find no sign of his wife, Sarah, a music teacher at his school. Next day, he reports her missing to the police, and as DS Annie Cassidy and DC Becky Hammond begin investigating, a puzzling discovery sends Alana in a tailspin. As more evidence emerges, Sarah's disappearance is escalated to high risk.

episodes:88579.name: Episode 2
episodes:88579.summary: Annie is struck by Michael's strangeness in the wake of an awful discovery, while Alana seeks comfort from her dad, but he appears to be in denial. As the case escalates, Ivan reminds Annie that her duties are restricted to family liaison, while Michael is frustrated by the detective and Becky's constant presence in the house.

episodes:88579.name: Episode 3
episodes:88579.summary: Michael expresses his discontent with the investigation during questioning, and Annie alights on a new suspect.

episodes:88579.name: Episode 4
episodes:88579.summary: Annie and her colleagues begin to see things in a new light as fresh information continues to emerge.

episodes:88579.name: Episode 5
episodes:88579.summary: Michael is increasingly isolated as the investigation broadens.

episodes:88579.name: Episode 6
episodes:88579.summary: The investigation hurtles towards a shattering conclusion.

show:the guardian.name: The Guardian
show:the guardian.summary: Nick Fallin is a hotshot lawyer working at his father's ultra successful Pittsburgh law firm. Unfortunately, the high life has gotten the best of Nick. Arrested for drug use, he's sentenced to do 1,500 hours of community service, somehow to be squeezed into his 24/7 cutthroat world of mergers, acquisitions and board meetings. Reluctantly, he's now The Guardian - a part-time child advocate at Legal Aid Services, where one case after another is an eye-opening instance of kids caught up in difficult circumstances.

episodes:2219.name: Pilot
episodes:2219.summary: Corporate Attorney, Nick Fallen has just been assigned to work community service hours in Children's Legal Services.

episodes:2219.name: Reunion
episodes:2219.summary: Nick decides to take legal action on an incident that is personal to him.

episodes:2219.name: Paternity
episodes:2219.summary: Nick works to help a prostitute and her 11-year-old handicapped son attempt to collect child support from his biological father.

episodes:2219.name: Lolita?
episodes:2219.summary: Nick is asked to represent a 15 year-old girl who accuses her cop father of raping her.

episodes:2219.name: The Men from the Boys
episodes:2219.summary: Fallin and Associates take on a sexual harassment case while Nick works to get a homeless gay teen off the streets.

episodes:2219.name: Indian Summer
episodes:2219.summary: While Nick and co-workers are unwinding after work at a bar (although Nick is reviewing some papers), he is propositioned by an attractive young woman. What seems like an innocent tryst, however, could turn Nick's career upside down. Meanwhile, Nick's boss at Children's Legal Services must present his proposal to renew the annual contract for the non-profit agency, and this is the first year he has any competition. Will CLS receive the needed funding again this year?

episodes:2219.name: Feeding Frenzy
episodes:2219.summary: Since Child Legal Services is now also assisting adults, Nick's first client is a mentally challenged young man whose mother is certain he's being taken advantage of by his neighbor, a drug dealer. However, there is not enough evidence for the court to decide the young man must move back home, until . . . something catastrophic happens. Meanwhile, Nick's friend at his dad's firm, Jake, is facing legal issues of his own, following a disturbing auto accident.

episodes:2219.name: Heart
episodes:2219.summary: One of the most heart-wrenching episodes I have ever seen on TV; how surprising it's in the first half of the freshman season for this show. I love when writers name an episode, and it relates in more than one way, as we see in the simple word "Heart." First, Nick represents a 12-year-old ("going on 40") girl who needs a heart transplant. And Nick's father struggles with an almost ironclad contract he wrote 30 years ago, and watches while the terms are used against a good friend.

episodes:2219.name: The Funnies
episodes:2219.summary: Barbara, the secretary at Legal Services of Pittsburgh, as well as Nick's co-worker/friend, needs his help. Her 16-year-old son is found with drugs in the vehicle he is driving, which leads to a tragedy. But her son won't divulge where he obtained the drugs, so he's facing hard times. Also, one of Fallin & Associates' clients is trying to sell his toy company, but the creator of a popular children's character doesn't want to give up his rights to the intellectual property. Also, Nick's African American friend, James, at Legal Services of Pittsburgh, is called upon to defend a Neo-Nazi whose landlord is trying to evict him on any possible cause, as the landlord is Jewish and is offended by the free paper his tenant publishes. James defends the man, but it also arouses his own feelings about the client's offensive beliefs.

episodes:2219.name: Loyalites
episodes:2219.summary: Nick interviews Louise Archer for his father's firm, but she announces she's already accepted position elsewhere. Fallin and Associates loses a lawyer to a competitor, Kirk & McGee, who then proceeds to try to poach other staff from Fallin's firm. Nick is assigned to work on a case with a new staff member at Legal Services of Pittsburgh, which involves an Arab American shopkeeper who used a bat against a vandal who broke into his store. Nick's father marathons sweet-talking all his clients that might be leaving due to the staff upheaval. As always, surprises ensue.

episodes:2219.name: Home
episodes:2219.summary: Nick's first CLS case is now up for the lawsuit against the drug company, which Burton negotiates, as well as where Hunter will live. Alvin's ex-wife appears, asking for his help as she wants to bring a wrongful termination suit against her former employer, which she claims is retaliation for whistle-blowing. And, we learn for the first time, that Nick has been involved in an illicit affair with a married woman.

episodes:2219.name: Causality
episodes:2219.summary: This episode begins on Friday night during a birthday celebration, and then we see the days leading up to the events of that night. Nick starts his new position at Kirk & McGee, but things are not going as well as he planned. He is assigned to represent a father/son business transaction, where he squares off with his own father at the negotiating table. At the new firm, Nick sees an unwelcome figure from his past. Alvin also faces his past during a mother's request to keep her young boy, and Lu makes a surprising discovery.

episodes:2219.name: Privilege
episodes:2219.summary: Nick and his father attend a funeral for a client's daughter, unsure if she was murdered for her trust money or not. Nick accidentally witnesses disturbing behavior by the decedent's sister, and many questions arise. Amanda dips her toes into pro bono work at Legal Services of Pittsburgh, and represents an older woman who claims her doctor is taking advantage of her financially; however, Amanda gets a surprise revelation during the hearing.

episodes:2219.name: Family
episodes:2219.summary: Nick's Aunt LIz and her son, Jeremy, come to ask for assistance as she negotiates a deal to sell her business, since she has been diagnosed with cancer. Nick learns his cousin's secret, and encourages him to admit his problem to Liz. Nick shares some words of wisdom with the teen, since Nick watched his mother fight cancer when he was about Jeremy's age. At LS/Pittsburgh, James Mooney has a new client from Thailand, who is supposedly looking for her uncle living in America.

episodes:2219.name: In Loco Parentis
episodes:2219.summary: Another gut wrenching episode from this company of writers. Lu represents a crack addicted woman recently out of rehab for a custody hearing, and has second thoughts about her client's ability to care for her children, so Nick is added to the defense team. The situation escalates to involve SWAT and a negotiator. At LS/Pittsburgh, James is asked to represent a 17-year-old young man who claims he did not consent to give up his parental rights for his girlfriend's baby. Burton asks Nick for a ride home after a surgical procedure on his eyes, but refuses to give specifics to Nick, except that he has had multiple operations.

episodes:2219.name: Solidarity
episodes:2219.summary: A mother seeks Nick's help to block her 17-year-old son's request for emancipation. Turns out, while he can't take her case, she has information that can help in a Fallin & Associates union contract negotiation. We meet James' nephew, sister and grandmother when the teenager goes to his mother's aid and events turn tragic. And a former girlfriend of Nick's shows up to see how he's doing, and whether he has room for her in his life.

episodes:2219.name: The Divide
episodes:2219.summary: Interpersonal relationships between the main characters get strained in some ways, and deepened in others. Nick represents two brothers who don't want to be separated, but only one has an immediate adoption offer, which forces Nick and Lu to face each other in court. Jake helps his parents out when his father's personal and business debts threaten the family home, and Jake finally meets a mutually interested lady friend. Nick's NA sponsor challenges Nick about his commitment to his recovery.

episodes:2219.name: Mothers of the Disappeared
episodes:2219.summary: Nick runs into an important person in both his and his father's lives, which may have a significant impact on both their futures. A woman asks for Nick's help, as a trust was set up for her young daughter who disappeared about 7 years ago, and she needs the trust money to save her home. Nick asks the detective who was on the case, and things get complicated from there. And Alvin and Laurie Solt, the social services worker, discover a mutual passion for helping juveniles who fall through the cracks when they need psychiatric evaluation and not just detention.

episodes:2219.name: Lawyers, Guns and Money
episodes:2219.summary: This episode has multiple subplots, and it appears Nick feels like his entire world is spinning out of control. (1) His parole officer threatens to report some technical violations to the judge, if Nick won't assist him with legal services while he tries to purchase and renovate a gentleman's club with his girlfriend, and the situation ends very badly for some parties involved. (2) A friend of a close friend asks Nick to bail him out of jail, but keep it all a secret. (3) Nick's father is being looked at for a federal judgeship, and Nick's legal problems could hinder this appointment, putting additional pressure on Nick. (4) At Legal Services, Nick represents a recent parolee whose ex-wife is trying to get his parental rights severed. (5) Lu personally invites Nick to her upcoming engagement party. (6) And, James' new guardianship with his nephew is already being challenged by the young man.

episodes:2219.name: Shelter
episodes:2219.summary: While visiting the house where Lu and Brian have placed an offer, Nick and the couple meet two homeless teens who need much help and guidance; Nick and Lu are assigned to represent these teens' interests in court. Nick's father divulges that he would like to leave the firm in Nick's hands, if he is appointed to the federal judgeship, and suggests Nick assist on of Burton's personal clients as a stepping stone, but it reveals to Nick some of his weaknesses. And Lu and Nick's friendship begins to move along a new path.

episodes:2219.name: The Chinese Wall
episodes:2219.summary: Burton surprises the firm with a new senior partner: a former senator, and his unscrupulous aide. Nick is advised he needs to drop one of his big clients, where there could be a conflict of interest with the senator, which is where the episode pulls its name from: "Chinese Wall." Lu is pulled into her grandmother's life when she falls in her nursing home and breaks a leg under questionable circumstances.

episodes:2219.name: The Beginning
episodes:2219.summary: Alvin is concerned about James' use of boxing to discipline his nephew; James ask Nick to represent him regarding parenting classes. Dr. Reed visits Nick again, concerned about his son's trust. With a new managing partner at the firm, Nick discusses starting a new firm with some of his colleagues. Mandy Gressler shows up unexpectedly, and threatens to jeopardize Nick's probationary status. Alvin attempts to support Nick in a difficult situation, but Nick shuts him down. And we are left with a suspenseful cliffhanger for the first season.

episodes:2219.name: Testimony
episodes:2219.summary: While Nick awaits probation revocation in jail, his father begins some investigative work about his story. First, the hospital to find out about Mandy's health status, where he meets Shannon, Mandy's daughter. Then Burton speaks to the detective who has been trying to locate Mandy for a month. And he meets Mary, Shannon's grandmother, for the first time. He asks Mary if Shannon can testify for Nick, but Mary refuses. James interviews with Caldwell, Fallin's new managing partner. Jake continues to work on getting Nick's firm started. Lulu visits Nick in jail, partly to ask him about a case she had to take over for him.

episodes:2219.name: Monster
episodes:2219.summary: (NO SPOILERS) Nick's first day back at LSP after his hearing is a very difficult one. A young man, about 13 years old, killed his mother. Ronnie seems to have a strange affect; disconnected, focused on concerns that are not super important. Nick also has a fender bender in the parking lot, which is an interesting first meeting of Kim. Also, James and Jake help Nick with the opening of their new law firm.

episodes:2219.name: The Dead
episodes:2219.summary: Nick sees an opportunity to get a former client at his new firm, and meets with the client at The Incline, the favorite watering hole for Burton's firm. The client is building a new property, and wants to build a road through a cemetery, which would require 15 graves to be relocated. Burton visits Mary at work, and finds out the reason Mandy hasn't been buried yet; Burton offers to help. The FBI puts pressure on some unscrupulous actions among major players. And a difficult issue from Burton's past arises during a current case, although he is on the verge of being sworn in as a judge. Kim and Nick continue their bedroom relationship.

episodes:2219.name: The Next Life
episodes:2219.summary: An "angel of death" nurse at a hospital confesses to killing 19 cancer patients; James' grandmother may have been one of them. While visiting the hospital, he meets a young woman whose husband also may be a victim. At LSP, Nick is asked to represent a child who has been difficult to adopt, so he can go to an "adoption party." Lulu represents a pregnant teenager who has an at risk pregnancy and needs to find a new shelter, as she doesn't like to follow rules.

episodes:2219.name: Assuming the Position
episodes:2219.summary: A raid on a Massage Parlor jeopardizes Alvin's job. Nick is appointed to represent a young boy who is having severe medical issues from lead exposure. Jake is pressed to the limit both personally and professionally as he tries to help a close friend. And we find out that Lulu's marriage is meeting neither her nor her husband's expectations.

episodes:2219.name: The Living
episodes:2219.summary: Nick's father has him take over a client with many secrets and idiosyncrasies; Nick begins to question his own personal motives while he does his job. Is it to be successful, meet his father's expectations, or purely for the money? Does his corporate job allow the "human factor" to be relevant? Nick also helps a teen who needs a bone marrow transplant from his sister, but her location is unknown. And Lu confides to Nick the reason she's mad at him.

episodes:2219.name: The Innocent
episodes:2219.summary: Nick and Jake help a family whose lives have been torn apart by cancer death of mother, and drug use by father. Fortunately, the children's godparents want to adopt them, and are a good home for them. However, it doesn't mean there aren't some large issues to overcome. Lulu is asked to help a man who was wrongfully imprisoned for decades as he tries to re-enter life outside prison and keep his marriage. And Nick and Lulu begin talking about her concerns about her marriage.

episodes:2219.name: The Neighborhood
episodes:2219.summary: A close friend of Lulu's has a daughter go missing, and foul play is suspected. Nick's father tries to celebrate Nick's birthday with a surprise. And Nick is assigned a new case, then discovers he knows the client from his childhood days, and the client needs help to retain custody of his dog.

episodes:2219.name: The Dark
episodes:2219.summary: Another appropriate name for a powerful episode. James' nephew, Levi, is assaulted by his former gang members at his reform school, and is threatened with expulsion unless he gives the headmaster the names of the assailants. Alvin represents a former baseball idol in a personal property dispute; Nick's dad has another eye surgery that compromises his ability to work, so Nick must take over a large merger on short notice, while he's juggling assisting others in his life, also with major personal issues.

episodes:2219.name: Sacrifice
episodes:2219.summary: Lulu's husband comes under scrutiny by the hospital after a problem in the operating room, and it puts Nick and Lulu on opposite sides of the courtroom. Nick's father meets a client's beautiful daughter, and wants Nick to date her. And a young mother is pushed to the limit in her multi-generational home where illness has taken over family function.

episodes:2219.name: No Good Deed
episodes:2219.summary: A client Nick has been working with for a long time graduates high school, and Nick offers him a temporary job. The first day, he follows Nick to his various duties, and his life is changed forever. Nick also represents a family where the father is mentally altered due to Acquired Brain Injury. Burton makes a generous offer to Mary and Shannon, and the friendship deepens. And Lulu needs representation, and Nick offers to help.

episodes:2219.name: You Belong to Me
episodes:2219.summary: Lulu has a stalker, and it's unclear who it is: repeat, silent phone calls, and a break-in while her husband is away. Burton gets a lead on picking up some of the city's legal matters, which can help the firm monetarily, but it conflicts with other duties at the law firm. Specifically, he sues a man to remove a nuisance aviary in his small back yard. And a mother who has been physically abused seems to feed her son with lies about his father, so he's afraid of him.

episodes:2219.name: Ambition
episodes:2219.summary: Nick gets a new client, and then finds out it's actually Lulu's mother, who is moving her business to Pittsburgh. She tries to entice Lulu away from her non-profit work and begin working with her as she builds her company in this new location. James represents a young man who has foster parents who want to adopt him, but the youngster is being enticed by a potential rap recording contract in New York. And a long time client of Burton's is wanting to expand his inherited business to a completely new business venture, and this encourages Burton to consider his "old fuddy duddy" ways.

episodes:2219.name: Understand Your Man
episodes:2219.summary: At a benefit dinner for LSP, Jake meets a "model" woman who recently got custody of her son. They happened to have gone to the same local high school, and there is a mutual interest. Since Jake is spending time with her, he begins to question if she is really a fit mother. After Burton is rebuffed, he rethinks his relationship with Mary, and Nick witnesses her true side. Brian files a suit against the hospital for wrongful termination. Nick represents a transvestite man whose partner is now deceased, and is trying to keep custody of the young boy he's been raising as his own for several years now. Lulu bid on some law books of Burton's, but the box which is delivered is more of a personal nature, and she begins to see how Nick was raised.

episodes:2219.name: Where You Are
episodes:2219.summary: A school friend of Nick's has a new product, and he's asking for the firm's assistance with a business plan, etc. Meanwhile, Lulu has a young boy who misses a lot of school. Nick has second thoughts about working with his friend, but his invention proves extremely effective at a crucial moment. James approaches his friend still at Fallin & Fallin, Jake, regarding an unscrupulous auto lending company for his latest client.

episodes:2219.name: The Weight
episodes:2219.summary: Barbara has some very exciting news, with invitations in hand for the entire office. Nick takes over a case for Lulu, where a terminally ill child has parents who disagree on the direction her care takes; Burton has a medical scare. And a factory in Burton's small hometown may have to close, which would devastate the community's economy.

episodes:2219.name: The Intersection
episodes:2219.summary: This episode shows how the lives of the different people in the accident intersect. We see how the accident happened and the cause, the people involved, and how they are affected by the accident and subsequent consequences. Nick has the opportunity to show us his most vulnerable side. Both Barbara and her fiance get difficult news.

episodes:2219.name: My Aim Is True
episodes:2219.summary: A young cop shoots Nick's former drug dealer while on duty, and Burton takes a hard line on the settlement after Nick removes himself from the case. Lulu's recovery goes well. A new probationary official visits Alvin's office to question Nick's hours reporting, since he also has a full time job. And Nick has to represent three of his former clients as they need to find new shelter when their facility shuts down.

episodes:2219.name: Back in the Ring
episodes:2219.summary: A popular local boxer seeks assistance with a custody issue, and Burton, Nick and Lulu attend his first big fight together. Nick takes Lulu replacement car shopping. Lulu is concerned about a teenage cheerleader into some questionable behavior, and works with Jake to assist her family. And Lulu's mother testifies before a grand jury.

episodes:2219.name: What It Means to You
episodes:2219.summary: The new temp attorney at Fallin & Fallin has two unusual encounters with a client which cause concern for Burton. Lulu is representing a church in an eminent domain dispute, and Nick is representing the opposite side. A close friend from Burton's recent past needs his help. And the "police officer vs drug dealer" lawsuit ends differently than any one was expecting.

episodes:2219.name: Burton & Ernie
episodes:2219.summary: Burton's nephew, Jeremy, begins exhibiting very disturbing behavior, and it affects the entire extended family. Lulu and Nick host their first dinner party as a couple. Jake buys a cabin in the woods and is excited about fixing it up. Shannon has trouble adjusting to life in a new environment and without her grandmother.

episodes:2219.name: Sensitive Jackals
episodes:2219.summary: Nick wants to diversify the firm with criminal law practice. Jake went to school with the best criminal defense lawyer in town, and Nick asks Jake to try to land him. Nick is assigned a client, Taliek, who was the victim of a brutal attack, and he's trying to get visitation rights. Nick and his father square off in a mock trial for credits toward continuing legal education (CLE). Lulu tells Nick she's going to interview for a great job in Berkeley, California. James realizes he may have made a tragic mistake about 6 months ago. We find out that Jake's relationship with Clay, the criminal defense attorney, may not be as friendly as we originally were led to believe. Nick tries to apologize to Shannon for humiliating her in front of several people.

episodes:2219.name: All the Rage
episodes:2219.summary: Lulu travels to Berkley for a job interview, which could split up Nick and Lulu. Shannon's father shows up to seek custody. James confesses about his past behavior, and many people get hurt. Nick is court-ordered for anger counseling, but he's resistant. And a parking spot becomes the last straw for two frustrated men.

episodes:2219.name: Carnival
episodes:2219.summary: Nick fights to keep a small boy whose mother performs in a traveling carnival in DCF custody when he claims he was molested by the carnival owner.

episodes:2219.name: Big Coal
episodes:2219.summary: Pressured to bring his own new business to the firm, Nick and Sadie Harper, Fallin & Fallin's new defense attorney associate, must get a town of 23 people to sign release settlements in order for Nick to land a huge coal manufacturer as a client.

episodes:2219.name: The Line
episodes:2219.summary: Nick gets caught between father/son clients when the sale of their family department store becomes complicated with a class action lawsuit from several African American customers claiming discrimination.

episodes:2219.name: The Father-Daughter Dance
episodes:2219.summary: Although a married couple wants Burton to sue a fertility clinic when their child is born black.

episodes:2219.name: Shame
episodes:2219.summary: When Fallin & Fallin's credit line is called in, Nick tries to get a longtime Fallin client who owes millions to pay in full; Burton and Nick lose him to firm.

episodes:2219.name: Let's Spend the Night Together
episodes:2219.summary: When Lulu's father decides to stay at her place, she and Nick agree they still have feelings for each other and agree to move in together.

episodes:2219.name: Hazel Park
episodes:2219.summary: As part of his community service, Nick is reassigned to help clean up an inner city park, where he meets a former LSP client he does not remember.

episodes:2219.name: Believe
episodes:2219.summary: Lulu tells Nick she is pregnant, and he proposes to her.

episodes:2219.name: Let God Sort 'Em Out
episodes:2219.summary: When Fallin & Fallin evict squatters from land being used for future developments, the ripple effect at LSP is tremendous.

episodes:2219.name: Swimming
episodes:2219.summary: Nick and Suzanne Pell attempt to help Christopher, a client at LSP, after he is locked in a closet for disciplinary measures at a teen boot camp.

episodes:2219.name: Legacy
episodes:2219.summary: Nick must find a kid a home after his father, who was recently let go from Kane Industries, went crazy and shot his boss and several other coworkers in a conference room during a meeting.

episodes:2219.name: Beautiful Blue Mystic
episodes:2219.summary: After Lulu leaves Nick for having an affiar with Suzanne, Burton counsels Nick to seek help at rehab.

episodes:2219.name: Amends
episodes:2219.summary: Alvin accuses Nick of rushing through the "steps" of working his recovery program.

episodes:2219.name: All Is Mended
episodes:2219.summary: Lulu informs Nick that their unborn baby has Downs Syndrome.

episodes:2219.name: Without Consent
episodes:2219.summary: Nick attempts to help a teenage boy who beat up his mother after he walked in on her and his best friend in bed.

episodes:2219.name: Sparkle
