episodes:33096.summary: Ainsley doubles down on her fight with Craig. Duffy stumbles upon a secret love letter that gives him hope. Kash considers taking the next step with Fatima.

episodes:33096.name: The Sound of Music
episodes:33096.summary: Maya feels guilty that her work is forcing her to interact with Ainsley's ex; Andrew and Tony 2 realize that they have an unexpected connection; Bryce tries to take his professional relationship with Ainsley to the next level.

episodes:33096.name: Game Night
episodes:33096.summary: Maya and Kash get to know each other behind Ainsley's back. Tony 2 realizes he and Andrew come from very different worlds. Ainsley and Craig play matchmaker, as do Gemma and Duffy.

episodes:33096.name: Four Friends and a Secret
episodes:33096.summary: Maya struggles to tell Ainsley about Kash. Fearing their relationship may be getting too friendly, Gemma fires Duffy. Zara finds a way for Craig to reconnect with his daughter. Andrew has a surprising change of heart.

episodes:33096.name: New Jersey
episodes:33096.summary: A year after Maya and Ainsley's blowup, the fractured friend group hopes that a wedding may be the perfect occasion for a reunion.

show:mermaids.name: Mako Mermaids
show:mermaids.summary: A boy is magically turned a merman, and discovers his underwater origins, after he comes in contact with the magic waters at the mysterious Mako Island guarded by a trio of mermaids.

episodes:4225.name: Outcasts
episodes:4225.summary: During a full moon, a land boy named Zac falls into the Moon Pool, and the power of the moon transforms him into a merman.

episodes:4225.name: Getting Legs
episodes:4225.summary: Sirena, Lyla and Nixie must turn Zac back into a land boy. Using Sirena's Moon Ring, they give themselves legs and walk on land to begin their task.

episodes:4225.name: Meeting Rita
episodes:4225.summary: Sirena, Lyla and Nixie follow Zac to school, but the school principal confronts them and takes Sirena's Moon Ring.

episodes:4225.name: Lyla Alone
episodes:4225.summary: When a waitress spills a drink on Lyla, she rushes to the cool room -- just before transforming into a mermaid!

episodes:4225.name: Blizzard
episodes:4225.summary: Rain keeps the mermaids indoors and unable to look for Zac. Lyla and Sirena try to use the Moon Ring to stop the rain, but they create a blizzard.

episodes:4225.name: Dolphin Tale
episodes:4225.summary: Joe has a new boat and takes it out for a spin. His fish finder locates a dolphin, but it's not like any dolphin he's seen before.

episodes:4225.name: Zac's Pool Party
episodes:4225.summary: Zac's struggle with his merman secret intensifies when his girlfriend, Evie, throws him a pool party.

episodes:4225.name: Zac's Return to Mako
episodes:4225.summary: It's a full moon, and the mermaids think that if they keep Zac out of the moonlight, he'll lose his powers and return to his land-dwelling self.

episodes:4225.name: The Siren
episodes:4225.summary: While listening to Sirena sing, Lyla has an idea: If Sirena sings the "Enchantment Song" to Zac, he'll fall under her spell.

episodes:4225.name: Zac Returns to Mako
episodes:4225.summary: Against Nixie and Sirena's advice, Lyla helps Zac get to the Moon Pool. But when the entrance suddenly closes, they're trapped inside.

episodes:4225.name: I Don't Believe in Mermaids
episodes:4225.summary: Fearing they'll never get the pod to return to Mako, a despondent Nixie finds herself at odds with Lyla and Sirena.

episodes:4225.name: Close Call
episodes:4225.summary: Sirena is collecting shells on the reef when she sees merman Zac. Luckily, she torpedoes away before he recognizes her.

episodes:4225.name: Betrayal
episodes:4225.summary: The full moon is once again upon Mako, and the mermaids have to stop Zac from getting the all-powerful Trident.

episodes:4225.name: Battlelines
episodes:4225.summary: Now that he knows Sirena, Lyla and Nixie are mermaids, Zac begins to wonder about his school principal, Rita, and why she helps them.

episodes:4225.name: Sirena's Secret
episodes:4225.summary: When David invites Sirena to sing with him at the café, their connection grows. Lyla and Nixie fear that she might not want to return to the sea.

episodes:4225.name: Truce
episodes:4225.summary: While showing off his brand-new smartphone, Cam takes video footage of Zac swimming as a merman.

episodes:4225.name: Moon Ring 2
episodes:4225.summary: Zac finds a Moon Ring on the ocean floor, and when he gives the ring to Evie, the mermaids know it's no ordinary ring -- they have to get it back.

episodes:4225.name: The Trident Job
episodes:4225.summary: The mermaids keep a close watch on Zac at the Halloween party, but he evades them with Cam's help.

episodes:4225.name: Where's the On Button
episodes:4225.summary: The Trident is every bit as powerful as Zac imagined -- but he can't get it to work. He wonders if the Trident needs to be activated by moonlight.

episodes:4225.name: Nowhere to Hide
episodes:4225.summary: The Trident is active and dangerous, and the mermaids must take it from Zac. Knowing this, Zac searches for the perfect hiding place.

episodes:4225.name: Aquata Returns
episodes:4225.summary: Sirena's sister, Aquata, returns to Mako with great news: Sirena can return to the pod. Unfortunately, the invitation isn't extended to Lyla and Nixie.

episodes:4225.name: Evie Times Two
episodes:4225.summary: When Rita's cat, Poseidon, steps through a puddle of mermaid powders, he is transformed into a person.

episodes:4225.name: Zac's Choice
episodes:4225.summary: Zac manages to find the Trident, but Lyla is right behind him. As the two battle for possession, a flash of energy knocks Lyla unconscious.

episodes:4225.name: Trust
episodes:4225.summary: While Lyla tries to teach Zac more about the ocean and mermaid history, Nixie refuses to trust him.

episodes:4225.name: Betrayed
episodes:4225.summary: Behind Sirena and Lyla's backs, Nixie helps Cam get into the Moon Pool to unlock the Trident. But Evie insists on coming along for the dive.

episodes:4225.name: Decision Time
episodes:4225.summary: When Cam takes the Trident to Mako behind Nixie's back, the mermaids realize that he intends to turn himself into a merman so he can rule Mako Island.

episodes:4225.name: The Seventh Cycle
episodes:4225.summary: When the pod decides Zac is a threat and must give up his merman powers, two new mermaids, Mimmi and Ondina, are sent to make sure he obeys.

episodes:4225.name: Sticky Situation
episodes:4225.summary: With Evie now a mermaid, Mimmi and Ondina try a dangerous spell to change her back to a human form, but the results are less than ideal.

episodes:4225.name: Discovery
episodes:4225.summary: When Zac has a powerful vision about his connection to Mako Island, he and the mermaids visit the island to investigate.

episodes:4225.name: A New Tail
episodes:4225.summary: Erik's curiosity about the girls and Mako Island becomes a problem when he decides to investigate further.

episodes:4225.name: Bad for Business
episodes:4225.summary: When Evie's dad decides to take tourists on dive charters to Mako Island, the gang must find a way to change his mind.

episodes:4225.name: Stormy Seas
episodes:4225.summary: Sirena gives Evie mermaid lessons, which rubs Ondina the wrong way, while Erik tries to get to the bottom of Zac and Cam's falling out.

episodes:4225.name: Awakening
episodes:4225.summary: With the full moon approaching, Zac's plan to avoid Mako Island is dealt a blow when his father insists they go on their annual camping trip.

episodes:4225.name: Land School
episodes:4225.summary: When Mimmi goes to the first day of the new school year, things get out of hand fast when she runs afoul of the science teacher.

episodes:4225.name: Stowaway
episodes:4225.summary: When a young mermaid follows Ondina back to Mako Island after a mermaid council meeting, it could spell trouble with the pod.

episodes:4225.name: Keeping the Secret
episodes:4225.summary: When David sees Evie in the water as a mermaid, it puts Zac and the girls' secret at risk unless they can convince David he's wrong.

episodes:4225.name: Only as Young as You Feel
episodes:4225.summary: Ondina adds too much jellyfish extract to Mimmi's body lotion, and the results put Principal Santos in dangerous waters at the marine park.

episodes:4225.name: Supersized
episodes:4225.summary: When Mimmi loses her moon ring in the Ocean Café's cooler room, it creates havoc for David and his brother's business.

episodes:4225.name: Reunion
episodes:4225.summary: On the night of the full moon, Zac and Erik swim to Mako Island and unlock the merman chamber, revealing a startling secret.

episodes:4225.name: A New Man
episodes:4225.summary: Zac struggles to come to terms with the news that he's a real merman, he's adopted and Mimmi is his sister.

episodes:4225.name: Careful What You Wish for
episodes:4225.summary: After Cam absorbs moon pool water, he discovers he has power over water, which gets him a place in the trials for the school swim team.

episodes:4225.name: First Date
episodes:4225.summary: Ondina sneaks Erik into the grotto to duplicate a pearl he gave her, but she accidentally turns him into a copy of Poseidon.

episodes:4225.name: The Merman Code
episodes:4225.summary: When Erik dives down and touches one of the rock outcrops on Mako reef, he's transported into a sphere of endless water with no way out.

episodes:4225.name: The Siren
episodes:4225.summary: When Sirena sees a video that shows a kayaker being lured by a mermaid's song, she starts to follow David obsessively, and he falls under her spell.

episodes:4225.name: Surprise!
episodes:4225.summary: A surprise birthday party is in the works for Evie, who accidentally shrinks herself and falls into an aquarium after trying on Mimmi's moon ring.

episodes:4225.name: The Job
episodes:4225.summary: Mimmi takes a job at the marine park, where she meets Chris, a young man who is desperate to get into a dolphin training program.

episodes:4225.name: New Orders
episodes:4225.summary: On the night of the full moon, Zac and Ondina sneak away to Mako, and Ondina reveals her plan to destroy the chamber.

episodes:4225.name: The Last Dance
episodes:4225.summary: Ondina doesn't want to choose between Erik and the pod when the pod returns. To cheer her up, Erik decides to throw a party in the café.

episodes:4225.name: Stay or Go
episodes:4225.summary: At the marine park, Ondina and Mimmi get into trouble when a dolphin splashes them and a little girl sees them transform into mermaids.

episodes:4225.name: The Truth About Evie
episodes:4225.summary: When Evie comes down with a fever that causes the temperature in the room to soar, Carly suspects that her friend is keeping a secret from her.

episodes:4225.name: The Trident Stone
episodes:4225.summary: When Erik learns that the trident stone is the missing element needed to activate the merman chamber, Zac gives it to the mermaids for safekeeping.

episodes:4225.name: The Chosen One
episodes:4225.summary: The chamber's true purpose is revealed: to drain the magic from all mermaids. Zac risks his life to shut it down and restore the mermaids' magic.

episodes:4225.name: A Visit from the East
episodes:4225.summary: Ondina is tasked with teaching the younger mermaids. A mermaid from China joins the pod. During a full moon ceremony, a terrifying beast emerges.

episodes:4225.name: Seeing Is Believing
episodes:4225.summary: When marine park workers are sent to investigate the reported sea monster, the mermaids must create a credible explanation to stop further inquiries.

episodes:4225.name: Recipe for Success
episodes:4225.summary: Weilan casts a knowledge transference spell on Zac to help him pass a biology test. But more than just science facts transfer from her body to his!

episodes:4225.name: Mopping Up
episodes:4225.summary: When Evie tries using her new moon ring to magically finish her chores, things quickly get out of control. Joe makes an upsetting announcement.

episodes:4225.name: The Puzzle Box
episodes:4225.summary: Weilan comes up with the idea of using a Chinese puzzle box to trap the sea dragon. Cam panics when Carly suggests they take dance lessons.

episodes:4225.name: New Beginnings
episodes:4225.summary: Evie's moon ring lesson with Ondina takes an unexpected turn. At the marine park, Mimmi discovers the reason for a rescued dolphin's distress.

episodes:4225.name: Turning the Tide
episodes:4225.summary: Zac begs Weilan to teach him an Eastern spell few have mastered, which he hopes to use against the dragon. Joe encounters a water ball.

episodes:4225.name: The Way of the Dragon
episodes:4225.summary: On the eve of the full moon, Ondina and Mimmi defy Veridia's orders. Evie becomes suspicious when she spots Zac and Weilan meeting in secret again.

episodes:4225.name: Reversal of Fortune
episodes:4225.summary: After overhearing Ondina blaming her for Evie's loss, Weilan runs off. Meanwhile, Mimmi and Ondina combine their powers to try to restore Evie.

episodes:4225.name: Wishful Thinking
episodes:4225.summary: Zac realizes a shell he found has magical powers, and he accidentally sends the mermaids back in time five years, where they meet his younger self.

episodes:4225.name: Lost and Found
episodes:4225.summary: While Ondina teaches the little mermaids to walk on land, her fastest-learning student wanders off and soon runs into Chris and Karl on the beach.

episodes:4225.name: Trust Issues
episodes:4225.summary: When Mimmi and Chris go on a date at the beach, Ondina goes to great lengths to protect her. Cam tries to lure more upscale customers to the cafe.

episodes:4225.name: Letting Go
episodes:4225.summary: Mimmi and Zac are startled by a mysterious yet strangely familiar vision. Cam's dual role as Carly's boss and boyfriend becomes difficult to manage.

episodes:4225.name: Age Before Beauty
episodes:4225.summary: Weilan mistakenly makes tea for Rita using a magic growth accelerator. Can the mermaids cure Rita before Mrs. Trumble takes over her principal job?

episodes:4225.name: The Legend of Jiao Long
episodes:4225.summary: A priceless artifact recovered by a deep-sea treasure hunter provides a clue as to how the mermaids can defeat the water dragon.

episodes:4225.name: Homecoming
episodes:4225.summary: The vision reappears to Mimmi and Zac, this time speaking to them. Weilan learns a new detail about the dragon legend that suggests Nerissa is alive.

show:platoon.name: Platoon 24/7: Preparing for War
show:platoon.summary:
As war rages in Eastern Europe, the British Army is readying its infantry platoons for action. These platoons – 30 strong units of soldiers who eat, sleep and fight alongside each other – are the backbone of the British Army.

This series follows one newly assembled platoon in The Rifles, the British Army's largest infantry regiment, preparing for possible frontline deployment. Filmed over six brutal months, they must develop soldiering skills to compete with a battle-hardened enemy and grow into a band of brothers so tight they will lay down their lives for each other.

episodes:90059.name: Episode 1
episodes:90059.summary: In episode one, the thirty soldiers of 13 Platoon, D Company, 5th Battalion The Rifles come together for the first time. They come from all different walks of life and corners of the country, most with little experience beyond basic training. Their challenge is to become a fighting unit, capable of deploying to Eastern Europe in six months' time.

episodes:90059.name: Episode 2
episodes:90059.summary: The platoon is back in Bulford after Top Dog. But no sooner have the Riflemen unpacked their bags when news arrives that Donald Trump intends to stop sharing American military intelligence with Ukraine, Keir Starmer says that Britain is ready to deploy a peacekeeping force within weeks. As Armoured Infantry, 13 Platoon could be some of the first deployed.

episodes:90059.name: Episode 3
episodes:90059.summary: The soldiers of 13 Platoon reach the end of their training, but ahead of them are the two biggest tests of the six months. First is Exercise Iron Storm, in which they will fight alongside tanks and artillery in a large-scale exercise across the Salisbury Plain Training Area, while the second challenge is an endurance competition staged on the inhospitable terrain of Dartmoor in Devon.

show:the great escape.name: The Great Escape
show:the great escape.summary: The Great Escape drops teams of ordinary people into the middle of their own epic action/adventure movie. Each week, three pairs of players will compete for a cash prize by escaping from such locations as a seven-story castle, a deserted island, a sinking ship or a maximum security prison. Players must use their wits, skills and whatever tools they can find to overcome obstacles, evade pursuers and make their way to freedom.

show:the pink panther.summary: The cartoon follows the adventures of an actual pink panther with the occasional cartoon starring Inspector Clouseau.

show:bill and ted s excellent adventure.name: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventures
show:bill and ted s excellent adventure.summary:
Picking up where the film left off, Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventures shows the further exploits of the future's greatest duo. Continued to be mentored by Rufus, the two manage find more adventures in time travel while trying to hold down a steady job at a hardware store.

The series was originally scheduled for an earlier season, but delayed for contractual reasons until Bill & Ted's Bogus Journey hit a specific box office gross. This explains why the two leads took over for voicing their characters in the animated series the year before.

episodes:9624.name: Nail the Conquering Hero
episodes:9624.summary: Keilson accidentally winds up in feudal times.

episodes:9624.name: As the Dude Turns
episodes:9624.summary: A soap star has a gender-identity crisis.

episodes:9624.name: It's a Totally Wonderful Life
episodes:9624.summary: Rufus tries to go back to when the pair met to save their friendship.

episodes:9624.name: Hunka Hunka Bill and Ted
episodes:9624.summary: The guys seek the original to win an Elvis impersonation contest.

episodes:9624.name: Destiny Babes
episodes:9624.summary: In 18th-century Italy, the guys seek tips from Casanova.

episodes:9624.name: Deja Vu

episodes:9624.name: Stand Up Guy

show:death valley.name: Death Valley
show:death valley.summary: Curmudgeonly retired actor meets eager young detective - they're the perfect crime-fighting duo, if they can only get along.

episodes:84670.name: Episode 1
episodes:84670.summary:
Disarming Welsh DS Janie Mallowan is desperate to solve some big cases and progress her career. While investigating the death by apparent suicide of wealthy property developer Carwyn Rees, she meets none other than John Chapel, the retired actor who played her TV detective idol, Inspector Charles Caesar. Eccentric and reclusive John uses his insight into character to deduce that Carwyn was murdered, though Janie is initially sceptical of his conclusions.

When forensics prove his theory right, Janie quietly asks him to help with the case. Having shut himself away from the world for years, John is initially reluctant to help. But together they work to solve an intriguing mystery involving an environmental activist, a grieving widow and a bitter business rival, painting the portrait of a man who kept a lot of secrets from those closest to him. And although John and Janie are not ready to admit it, this first case is the start of an iconic crime-solving partnership, and a friendship, too.

episodes:84670.name: Episode 2
episodes:84670.summary: After a walker is found dead on a Welsh mountain trail, John's insight into the unidentified woman quickly turns this into a murder investigation. Janie ropes John into joining her mam Yvonne's walking group to help solve the case and crack the identity of this mysterious woman. John is reluctant to go out and socialise, but he can't resist the call of another mystery. John and Janie join forces to solve two mysteries: the identity of the victim and a cunning murder plot with a large dose of blackmail and revenge. Janie's fierce defence of one of the suspects reveals more about her past, while John finds himself out of the house and enjoying himself a lot more than he's ready to admit...

episodes:84670.name: Episode 3
episodes:84670.summary: Janie is tasked with solving the murder of divisive best man Gethin Bennion the night before a wedding. What initially seems to be a burglary gone wrong quickly unravels complicated family dynamics and betrayed friendships, revealing just how far people will go for love. Janie is forced to face up to her personal experience of a friendship turned sour in order to connect with a suspect and crack the case. Meanwhile, John forms an unlikely connection with one of the suspects over art and painting, forcing him to re-evaluate the role that work played in his own marriage and the circumstances around his late wife's passing.

episodes:84670.name: Episode 4
episodes:84670.summary: Following the murder of coastal town businesswoman and am-dram theatre director Menna Hughes, Janie is eager to solve the case and land the DI promotion she desperately wants. She enlists John's help, but bristling at Janie's insinuation that he might have ‘lost' his acting chops, John takes matters into his own hands and joins the cast of the theatre group's next play. What starts out as a murder investigation soon becomes a cathartic journey for John, who is unexpectedly reminded of why he fell in love with acting in the first place. As for Janie, witnessing a downtrodden suspect finally stand up for themselves inspires her to confront her own demons from the past.

episodes:84670.name: Episode 5
episodes:84670.summary: A murder mystery event turns into a real murder investigation when famous Welsh actor and TV detective Anthony Hart is found stabbed to death at the dinner table. There's a lot of pressure on Janie to solve this murder, which isn't helped by the fact that John is close friends with Helena Hart, the sister of the deceased. John and Janie's investigation reveals not only a feud between siblings warring over property and their family's legacy, but also the pitfalls of fame and the kind of person Anthony really was. John finds himself rekindling his fledgling romance with old flame Helena, but ultimately, it's through an unexpected connection with a suspect that he is reminded of the dangers of living in the past, which inadvertently helps Janie let go of her own baggage. For Janie, this case is also the final hurdle before landing her DI position.

episodes:84670.name: Episode 6
episodes:84670.summary: Janie has been avoiding John ever since Clarke learned the truth about their partnership and put her promotion on ice. But an unexpected gesture from Clarke's boss sees John's role as a consultant with Mid Wales police made official. This forces John and Janie to find a new normal and rekindle their connection. They're tasked with solving the murder of Janie's mechanic, Dean Ward, which took place during a school reunion party at Janie's old school. As John and Janie dig deeper into Dean's death, links emerge to DC Chaudhry's recently unearthed cold case, a body uncovered in a drain. This forces Janie to revisit the events that led to her teenage best friend Sian's suicide fifteen years ago. John's instincts about the case puts him and Janie at odds, eventually forcing them to acknowledge the importance of their friendship. But as the series comes to an end, John upends their reconciliation with unexpected news…

episodes:84670.name: Episode 1
episodes:84670.summary:
A community service group find themselves under suspicion when one of their members, car salesman Eddie Morris, is pushed off the tower of a ruined castle around which the group are working. John and Janie are brought together by DCI Clarke to solve the case. However, following the shocking revelation that John has been dating Janie's mam, Yvonne, tensions remain high between the two. Though they haven't spoken in months, our crime-fighting duo must now remain professional if they hope to solve Eddie's murder.

Janie tries to give the case her full attention while getting to grips with the demands of her new, long-awaited promotion to detective inspector. As if this weren't enough, she's also living with pathologist Baxter, having moved out of her mum's house as an act of rebellion while Yvonne continues her relationship with John. Meanwhile, John employs a different tactic for the investigation by going undercover, as himself, in the community service group. John hopes to gain a better understanding of the suspects and use his signature character analysis to seek out the guilty party.

In the community service group, John and Janie question their list of suspects, which include the deceased's spiteful ex-wife, a sarky young offender, a hardened criminal, a disgraced Welsh politician and their happy-go-lucky supervisor. With mounting pressures, both personal and professional, will Janie and John be able to put their differences aside and solve the mystery?

episodes:84670.name: Episode 2
episodes:84670.summary:
In the quaint fishing village of Abertonnau, a trendy food shack is burned down with its owner inside. Janie arrives to investigate the murder of chef Scott Winstanley. Despite her best efforts to coax a downtrodden John from his self-imposed seclusion, Janie is seemingly unable to recruit him to help on the case.

However, upon arrival at The Ship, a neighbouring pub to the food shack, Janie is surprised to learn of an unexpected guest staying at the inn. John Chapel has checked himself in for a few days. The stay is, by John's account, a chance to recover from heartbreak. Despite this, Janie knows John can't help himself when a chance to solve a mystery appears. The pair start to interview the locals, which include the owners of The Ship – a brother-sister duo who can't keep the pub alive, an abrasive visiting ecologist and the last fisherman in town.

John and Janie begin to understand what's really going on in Abertonnau under the calm surface of the town. Fierce business rivalries, a waning fishing industry and a rare breeding seal colony all make up pieces of the puzzle – but can John assuage his aching heart long enough to crack the case? And can Janie live up to her new DI responsibilities while still being the detective she wants to be?

episodes:84670.name: Episode 3
episodes:84670.summary:
On the set of an epic Welsh TV drama, The Mabinogion, a runner is found dead in a young starlet's trailer. John and Janie are called to investigate the crew, and as they journey into the glamorous world of TV production, Janie finds herself starstruck by the actors, while John is simply struck by how much of an outsider he feels.

They begin their interviews with the young lead of the show, Welsh actress Olivia Whitmore, who, to Janie's surprise, is incredibly down to earth. She and Olivia click immediately, causing John to question whether Janie is able to put her personal connection aside and stay open to all suspects. Janie's potential conflict of interest is soon put into perspective, however, when they encounter the next interviewee, Randall St Clair, the actor who played John's old Caesar sidekick, who is a little frostier with John than expected. The duo explore the rest of the crew, which includes a stalactite-obsessed set designer, a laddish medic and an old-school make-up designer.

On-set injuries, secret affairs and badly behaved owls all lead Janie and John towards the answer. But forced back into the world of his former life, can John summon what's needed to uncover the truth, and can Janie remain professional when her new friend is a prime suspect?

episodes:84670.name: Episode 4
episodes:84670.summary:
Janie arrives at a new age commune after its founder, Sebastian ‘Chief' Granger, is found impaled on a horse plough during a crucial vote on the the commune's future. DI Janie is on the case but seems uncharacteristically keen to put the murder to bed quickly. Her reasons become clear when one of the community members is revealed to be her estranged father, Michael. Janie enlists the help of her trusty consultant John Chapel, but gives him a clear warning that her father is as unreliable as he is charming and that John is not to be taken in.

Despite this, John finds himself clicking with Michael and is unable to understand Janie's harsh assessment of her father. This point of contention between our crime-solving pair causes them to split up for the investigation. As they interview the commune members, John and Janie meet the fierce de facto new leader, a vegan lifestyle influencer, together with her devoted husband, and an angry neighbouring farmer and her meek adult son.

Disappointing parents, hidden romances and vegan bean-curd cheese are at the centre of this case. As Janie looks into the murder, old, complicated feelings around Michael are brought to the fore. Will his presence in Janie's life prove to be the disruptive force she predicted, or is John's new friendship with Michael proof that bad dads can change?

episodes:84670.name: Episode 5
episodes:84670.summary:
On a hot Saturday, Janie is roped into running a rehabilitation course for rule-breaking officers at Trebach CID. An already unpleasant atmosphere goes from bad to worse when Clarke drops in to say hello to one of the attendees – his old boss Phil Holmes – and finds him dead in the men's toilets. With enough evidence to consider the death foul play, Janie locks down the office, considering all the attendees as suspects in Phil's murder. On Clarke's command, John joins the team to work against the clock and solve the case.

Having been put on the course for various conduct mistakes, the group are not the most honest coppers going. Clarke's old nemesis, an exercise-crazed PC, a high-ranking workaholic civilian officer, a mild-mannered dog handler and an up-and-coming young DS make up the suspects. Can Janie and John use their skills to suss out the culprit and gather enough evidence in time to make an arrest?

While focused on the case, Janie struggles to find time for her renewed relationship with her dad. Balancing the two men in her life – Michael and John – and solving a murder in a lockdown puts Janie through her paces. Skeletons from the past, reigniting old flames and curry on the hottest day of the year are all on the cards during this investigation. Can John and Janie bring Phil's killer to justice? And will Michael's continued appearances disturb John and Janie's dynamite partnership?

episodes:84670.name: Episode 6
episodes:84670.summary:
At the memorial service for a rugby club's groundsman, the discovery of another death shocks the attendees. When the body of the club chairperson, Rachel Jenkins, is found in a function room, Janie and John must scrutinise everyone linked to the rugby club. With Janie's big move looming, this is set to be her last case for a while, and John starts to consider how his life will look without her.

Whilst exploring the competitive world of rugby on the case, John and Janie encounter an eclectic mix of characters, including a star rugby player at the start of his career, his competitive has-been father, the recently widowed barmaid, a humdrum firefighter and the endlessly positive captain of the women's team. Janie worries the young rugby star might be doing too much to please his dad. John has similar worries about Janie. Despite Janie's misgivings, John gets to know the suspects on the pretext of putting on a one-man show in the club's function room. Though the two find themselves at odds once again, they must pool their skills to find the murderer.

During their investigations, Janie and John find washed-up athletes, pitch-side interviews and a scuba-diving accident will all lead them towards the answer. But once the case is solved, and the dust has settled, what will become of John and Janie's partnership?

show:boar.name: Murder Board
show:boar.summary: Murder Board tells shocking murder stories in which the "murder wall" plays a crucial part in solving the crime. Ever wonder how detectives piece together and picture an entire murder investigation? This series unravels the baffling murder cases and how detectives bring haunting killers to justice.

episodes:42999.name: Death in a Cemetery
episodes:42999.summary: When a retired detective from the Jacksonville Sheriff's Office, is found beaten and shot in a local cemetery, it will take covert surveillance and an undercover sting to bring his killer to justice.

episodes:42999.name: An Evil Affair
episodes:42999.summary: At first, the fatal shooting of Linda Marie Brown seems like an open and shut case. Linda's teenage stepdaughter, Cinnamon is found comatose nearby clutching a suicide note that reads, "I didn't mean to hurt her."

episodes:42999.name: Murder on the Trail
episodes:42999.summary: The partially clothed and badly beaten body of a teenage girl is found hidden off a popular hiking trail. All that's left behind is her dog who she was walking at the time of her death.

episodes:42999.name: Scorned in Sin City
episodes:42999.summary: A multimillionaire real estate mogul has been missing for three weeks when a bullet-riddled skull is found in the Nevada desert; Las Vegas homicide detectives quickly discover that the missing man is no angel.

episodes:42999.name: The Preacher's Secret
episodes:42999.summary: When a women is found in a pool of blood on the bedroom floor, investigators learn just a few months before her death, the FBI had warned the victim someone had tried to hire a hit man on the 'dark' web to kill her. But there's more to this story.

episodes:42999.name: House of Terror
episodes:42999.summary: A couple is found bludgeoned to death in bed, and investigators learn the woman's toddler has witnessed the entire thing.

episodes:42999.name: Dead End Alley
episodes:42999.summary: After a lawyer is found brutally beaten and stomped to death in an alley, detectives are faced with a daunting puzzle that includes theories about prostitution, clandestine groups and contract killing.

episodes:42999.name: Coffee Shop Killer
episodes:42999.summary: When the day manager arrives for her shift at a coffee shop in Washington, she stumbles on the lifeless bodies of three coworkers, all shot multiple times.

show:hunted.name: Hunted
show:hunted.summary: Sam is a spy, a hunter who now finds herself hunted by a ruthless hidden enemy. Trapped in an intricate web of suspense and paranoia, she must discover who wants her dead by confronting her past.

episodes:392.name: Mort
episodes:392.summary: After being betrayed and nearly killed in Tangier, private security operative Sam Hunter recovers in a remote cottage. She soon returns to London to resume work for her employer, Byzantium, and determine which of her colleagues set her up. Her new assignment: posing as a tutor to the grandson of criminal multi-millionaire, Jack Turner.

episodes:392.name: LB
episodes:392.summary: After a colleague is kidnapped by the criminal multimillionaire she is spying on, Sam is ordered to kill him to keep him from being tortured and compromising the team. But her colleague delivers a stunning revelation - he has information on who tried to assassinate her in Tangier. If Sam carries out the order to kill him, she will never find out.

episodes:392.name: Hourglass
episodes:392.summary: Travelling undercover with the criminal multimillionaire she is spying on, Sam comes face-to-face with Bernard Faroux, the Frenchman she seduced and betrayed in Tangier. He offers to tell her who tried to assassinate her, but only if she gives vital information to him instead of Byzantium.

episodes:392.name: Kismet
episodes:392.summary: After witnessing a brutal murder, Sam discovers that Jack Turner, the criminal multi-millionaire she is spying on, is engaged in sabotage to make millions on the stock market. But the discovery comes too late for her colleague, Aidan Marsh, who rushes to stop a London office tower from exploding - only to get caught in the blast.

episodes:392.name: Ambassadors
episodes:392.summary: A mysterious assassin tells Sam that he is trying to protect her from Hourglass, a conspiracy orchestrated by five multinational corporations. Sam's investigation of the conspirators takes her to a country estate where she had been years before - it was where she was taken as a child after her mother was murdered and she was kidnapped.

episodes:392.name: Polyhedrus
episodes:392.summary: Sam suspects that Jack Turner intends to assassinate Fatima Zahir, a Pakistani presidential candidate opposed to the sale of the dam he is trying to buy. Sam and the team race to save Zahir's life, only to discover Turner has an even more important target - a scientist possessing a deadly secret that implicates Byzantium's own client.

episodes:392.name: Khyber
episodes:392.summary: Jack Turner demands he be awarded the dam, revealing he has evidence implicating Byzantium's client in a terrible crime. With the operation nearly over, Aidan presses Sam to revisit childhood memories of her mother's murder and her own kidnapping - to understand the reasons why the Hourglass conspirators have targeted her for death.

episodes:392.name: Snow Maiden
episodes:392.summary: Byzantium is ordered to kill Jack Turner, but when the assassination attempt fails, Sam is exposed as a spy, and trapped inside the house. Turner produces the evidence he has against Byzantium's client, while Sam - secretly being poisoned to death - at last begins to recover terrible memories that explain why the Hourglass conspirators want her dead.

show:infested.name: Infested!
show:infested.summary: The true stories of people whose homes were infested by animals ranging from ants and spiders to raccoons and snakes are told through reenactments, with the victims themselves participating.

show:barbershop.name: Barbershop
show:barbershop.summary: Barbershop, based on the successful feature films. Most of the characters from the popular "Barbershop" movies have been retained, headed by Calvin, the reluctant hero and neighborhood confessor who runs the barbershop he inherited from his father. A few new memorable characters have also been added to the world. The continuing comical exploits of these people will be explored along with contemporary issues facing them, set against the slowly gentrifying backdrop of this fictional Chicago neighborhood.

episodes:30566.name: This is My Bullshit, and You're Welcome to It
Madonna is a 'Ho (and Dana's Fucking Blind)
A Black Man Invented the Stoplight

show:creepshow.name: Creepshow
show:creepshow.summary: Creepshow, the anthology series based on the 1982 horror comedy classic, is still the most fun you'll ever have being scared! A comic book comes to life in a series of twelve vignettes over six episodes, exploring terrors from murder to the supernatural and unexplainable. Haunted dollhouses, werewolves, murderous goblins, villainous trick-or-treaters, the dead, and medical marvels are just a few of the things to watch out for in this new series. You never know what will be on the next page...

episodes:37790.name: Gray Matter
episodes:37790.summary: A small-town man turns to drink after his wife dies, but accidentally consumes contaminated beer and starts... changing.

episodes:37790.name: The House of the Head
episodes:37790.summary: A young girl, Evie, populates her dollhouse with a family, the Smith-Smiths. Evie soon discovers that the dollhouse is haunted by a severed head that kills every doll that it encounters.

episodes:37790.name: Bad Wolf Down
episodes:37790.summary: The surviving members of B Company take refuge in an abandoned police station. A woman is imprisoned inside, providing them with a way to escape the Nazis who have surrounded the building.

episodes:37790.name: The Finger
episodes:37790.summary: Divorced and alone, Clark Wilson finds a finger and brings it home. It soon grows into a small lizardlike creature and does whatever Clark wants...when Clark wants his enemies dead.

episodes:37790.name: All Hallow's Eve
episodes:37790.summary: Five trick-or-treaters go out to ask for treats... and tend to unfinished business.

episodes:37790.name: The Man in the Suitcase
episodes:37790.summary: A down-and-out college student grabs the wrong bag at the airport, and finds a man inside, twisted to fit and suffering from a strange condition.

episodes:37790.name: The Companion
episodes:37790.summary: A teenage boy flees from his abusive older brother and takes refuge in an old farmhouse which has a unique scarecrow watching over it.

episodes:37790.name: Lydia Layne's Better Half
episodes:37790.summary: Executive Lydia Layne promotes a man over her lover Celia, and then shares an elevator ride with Celia afterward.

episodes:37790.name: Night of the Paw
episodes:37790.summary: A fleeing woman crashes her car and seeks refugee in a funeral home. The owner tells her the tale of the monkey's paw that he owns... and how it cursed his life.

episodes:37790.name: Times Is Tough in Musky Holler
episodes:37790.summary: After the Change, the townspeople of Musky Holler turn on the mayor and his goons who forced them to watch as they dispatched anyone who opposed them.

episodes:37790.name: Skincrawlers
episodes:37790.summary: An overweight Henry Quayle refuses to try a new leech-based weight-loss program, and soon discovers that he was right to suspect it.

episodes:37790.name: By the Silver Water of Lake Champlain
episodes:37790.summary: After her father dies in Lake Champlain, his daughter Rose continues her quest to find the fabled lake monster.

episodes:37790.name: Model Kid
episodes:37790.summary: Joe's closest friends are the models toys of his favorite scary movie monsters.

episodes:37790.name: Public Television of the Dead
episodes:37790.summary: A public TV station is overwhelmed when the appraisal of an antique book accidentally summons a dark force.

episodes:37790.name: Dead and Breakfast
episodes:37790.summary: A marketing ploy at a haunted Bed and Breakfast becomes way too realistic.

episodes:37790.name: Pesticide
episodes:37790.summary: An exterminator gets more than he bargained for when he takes on a big job.

episodes:37790.name: The Right Snuff
episodes:37790.summary: A misunderstanding in space ensures two astronauts go down in history for all the worst reasons.

episodes:37790.name: Sibling Rivalry
episodes:37790.summary: Lola is convinced her brother is trying to kill her but she's worried about the wrong monster.

episodes:37790.name: Pipe Screams
episodes:37790.summary: A complicated drain clog.

episodes:37790.name: Within the Walls of Madness
episodes:37790.summary: Scientists fight to contain the creature they've been studying.

episodes:37790.name: Night of the Living Late Show
episodes:37790.summary: Simon has invented an incredible virtual reality experience that allows him to join in on his favorite films but is unprepared for when virtual reality becomes his actual reality.

episodes:37790.name: Mums
episodes:37790.summary: Jack's mother is taken from him, but her garden leaves more to remember her by than he first thought.

episodes:37790.name: Queen Bee
episodes:37790.summary: Three teens meet their favorite pop star and realize she's not at all what they imagined.

episodes:37790.name: Skeletons in the Closet
episodes:37790.summary: A movie buff opens a prop museum, but a rival collector could put everything at risk.

episodes:37790.name: Familiar
episodes:37790.summary: Jackson is being followed by a dark force, but will his attempts to rid himself of it work?

episodes:37790.name: The Last Tsuburaya
episodes:37790.summary: An art collector could never have anticipated the ways a terrifying painting would change his life.

episodes:37790.name: Okay, I'll Bite
episodes:37790.summary: Life in prison is tough, but Elmer's pet spiders always have his back.

episodes:37790.name: Stranger Sings
episodes:37790.summary: A siren lures a doctor into her trap to carry out a diabolical plan.

episodes:37790.name: Meter Reader
episodes:37790.summary: A teenage girl must fight off a demonic plague when she realizes her family might be infected.

episodes:37790.name: Time Out
episodes:37790.summary: Tim finds the answer to needing more hours in the day, but is it worth the cost?

episodes:37790.name: The Things in Oakwood's Past
episodes:37790.summary: When a small town opens a time capsule, the local librarian must try to keep history from repeating itself.

episodes:37790.name: Drug Traffic
episodes:37790.summary: A family is detained, and a young girl's distressing symptoms quickly escalate without her medication.

episodes:37790.name: A Dead Girl Named Sue
episodes:37790.summary: When the dead rise from their graves, townspeople take justice into their own hands.

episodes:37790.name: Twenty Minutes with Cassandra
episodes:37790.summary: Cassie is being chased by a monster and endangers a kind stranger when she asks for help. By doing so, they are both trapped, but what can they do?

episodes:37790.name: Smile
episodes:37790.summary: A celebrated photographer, finds himself tormented due to an award-winning photograph. Sometimes a picture isn't worth more than a thousand words.

episodes:37790.name: The Hat
episodes:37790.summary: A horror novelist has severe writer's block. Fortunately, his agent has just the right thing. The hat worn by none other than Stephen Bachman. Of course, the struggling author can't resist… he also can't write if he stops wearing the hat, which takes away all concepts of time and space.

episodes:37790.name: Grieving Process
episodes:37790.summary: Richard finds himself in quite a predicament. His wife has been attacked and is but a shell of the woman he loved. Within a short time, Richard is ready to do anything to help her feel better. This is put to the test and it appears Richard is ready to deliver.

episodes:37790.name: Parent Death Trap
episodes:37790.summary: Lyle is a disappointment to his wealthy parents, who constantly meddle in his life. Unfortunately, their plan backfires, and now he has to deal with the aftermath.

episodes:37790.name: To Grandmother's House We Go
episodes:37790.summary: Marcia needs to take her stepdaughter to the girl's grandmother's house to claim their inheritance. However, this simple task is easier said than done.

episodes:37790.name: Meet the Belaskos
episodes:37790.summary: The Belaskos get more than they bargained for when they move in next door to a vampire-hating suburbanite.

episodes:37790.name: Cheat Code
episodes:37790.summary: A father and son bond by playing an old video game, but soon find out there's a reason it was abandoned.

episodes:37790.name: Something Burrowed, Something Blue
episodes:37790.summary: A young couple are gifted everything they could ever wish for.

episodes:37790.name: Doodles
episodes:37790.summary: An aspiring comic artist keeps hitting roadblocks.

episodes:37790.name: George Romero in 3-D!
episodes:37790.summary: A struggling bookstore owner finds unpublished works of George Romero, but the comics lead to new troubles.

episodes:37790.name: Baby Teeth
episodes:37790.summary: Shelby's mom struggles to accept that her baby is growing up, but hanging on to childhood relics isn't as harmless as she thinks.

show:baby boom.name: Baby Boom
show:baby boom.summary: A comedy series based on the feature film of the same title. Kate Jackson portrays J.C. Wiatt, a high-powered executive who suddenly becomes a mother to a child left in her care by a relative who has died.

episodes:27222.name: Bring in Your Bad, Myrtle
episodes:27222.summary: Kate Jackson plays J.C. Wiatt, executive and single mother, in this series based on the 1987 film. In the pilot, J.C. tries to cope with a new assistant at work and a lost "blankie" at home.

episodes:27222.name: Guilt
episodes:27222.summary: J.C. gets some advice from TV moms Margaret Anderson and June Cleaver.

episodes:27222.name: Center
episodes:27222.summary: J.C. finagles her way into an intensive learning course for Elizabeth, but the experience may be too intense---for J.C.

episodes:27222.name: Stress
episodes:27222.summary: J.C. stands back to look at her life when she begins to fear that, like her father, she'll die of a heart attack.

episodes:27222.name: Saturday
episodes:27222.summary: J.C. is sure that Elizabeth is on an outing with a mass murderer and a '60s burnout.

episodes:27222.name: The He-Man Woman's Hater Club
episodes:27222.summary: J.C. and Arlene feel like they're back in the Dark Ages when they face discrimination at an all-male club.

episodes:27222.name: I'll Be Home for Christmas
episodes:27222.summary: J.C. makes sure Santa goes to town for her first Christmas with Elizabeth, while Fritz celebrates his wife's return from the Betty Ford Center.

episodes:27222.name: One Wednesday
episodes:27222.summary: J.C. waits to hear about a big account, Charlotte waits to hear about her raise and Fritz waits to hear about a date.

episodes:27222.name: X-Y-L-O-P-H-O-N-E
episodes:27222.summary: J.C. finds her dating drought quenched by a wonderful guy, but she hopes an old pattern's not repeating itself when he seems afraid of being eaten alive by the "Tiger Lady."

episodes:27222.name: When It Rains
episodes:27222.summary: J.C. has her hands full when Helga quits, Elizabeth gets sick, the doctor is cute, and the parade of unsuitable nannies seems endless.

episodes:27222.name: A Fine Romance
episodes:27222.summary: When J.C. passes out after her gym workout, she awakens to see the handsome Dr. Kevin Atwater back in her life. The good doctor is no longer engaged, and asks J.C. out to dinner.

episodes:27222.name: Charlotte's Secret
episodes:27222.summary: Charlotte makes several mistakes in J.C.'s schedule and then apologizes for being so tired and inattentive. J.C. later discovers the source of Charlotte's problems when she attends a local comedy club.

episodes:27222.name: J.C.--The Man
episodes:27222.summary: J.C. casually wishes she was a man, so she could see how the other half lives. When she wakes up the next day, she finds her wish has come true, and spends her day noticing all the differences.

show:would you rather.name: Would You Rather?
show:would you rather.summary:
Would You Rather? A popular game that has taken the country — and social media — by storm. So big, Tina Fey and Amy Poehler kicked off the Golden Globes with a friendly game of Would You Rather … Colin Farrell or Colin Firth? Ed Norton or Mark Ruffalo?

Whether you're playing PG versions with your family or R-rated versions at the local bar, the game has taken on a life of its own. And now, Nat Geo WILD is the first network to get into the fray, letting viewers decide what programming they want to watch with the first-ever Would You RatherWILD Wednesdays in February.

Viewers decide if they would rather watch tiny or big animals, furry or scaly ones, ones that swim or slither, or ones that live in a hot or cold climate.

episodes:27250.name: #WILDfur vs #WILDscales
episodes:27250.summary: Featuring either fury animals such as ice bears, wolves and cheetahs or scaly creatures including bluefin tuna, crocodiles and deadly snakes

episodes:27250.name: #WILDtiny vs #WILDbig
episodes:27250.summary: Pitting the animal kingdom's mini-me's such as hummingbirds and killer shrimp against killer whales, apes and giant pandas

episodes:27250.name: #WILDswim vs #WILDslither
episodes:27250.summary: Presenting blue whales and sharks in one corner and king cobras and anacondas in the other

episodes:27250.name: #WILDhot vs #WILDcold
episodes:27250.summary: Setting African butterfly fish and eel catfish opposite camping friends bears and caribou

show:hunter hunter.name: Hunter
show:hunter hunter.summary: It is 1977 and the seeds of our distrust in the American government are growing. Spymaster General Baker is told to start a new covert agency of six agents. His first choice is retired "Agency" spy, now Santa Barbara (CA) bookstore owner, Jim Hunter.

episodes:55394.name: Bluebird is Back
episodes:55394.summary:
The caper concerns a man who hires nuclear power plant specialists. Seems he's bee selling low-grade intelligence about U.S. nuclear power plants "to the other side."
The cad plans to turn double-agent. But he is terminated with extreme prejudice at a zoo where U.S. agents are waiting for him to meet "the other side." The doom is done with a four-pointed metal weapon, "the death star," a device Hunter recognizes as the trademark of a years-ago foe named "Bluebird," an ace Communist intelligence agent he hates.

episodes:55394.name: Mirror Image
episodes:55394.summary: By subjecting one of their own people to plastic surgery and re-education, the Reds create an exact replica of secret agent Jim Hunter (James Franciscus) for the purpose of using the false Hunter to get the true Hunter out of their hair. Their plan is to use the false Hunter to lure Baker (Ralph Bellamy), the US. Intelligence Kingpin who is Hunter's supervisor, into a trap and to kill him before witnesses, thereby framing the true Hunter for the murder of his boss. Proceeding with the first phase of the plan, the Soviet agents kidnap Hunter in order to isolate him temporarily. Then they palm off the false Hunter on Marty Shaw (Linda Evans), Hunter's lover and fellow secret agent, tensely waiting to see if the imposter will pass this most meticulous test.

episodes:55394.name: Lysenko Syndrome
episodes:55394.summary: Using an experimental mind-altering technique, Russian agents program Marty Shaw to  assassinate her uncle, US. Admiral Carleton Young, in a plot that also calls for the murder of James Hunter. William Windom guest stars as one of the Soviets. While Marty is unaware she has been subjected to psychological tampering, Hunter suspects, "something" has happened to her, though he is mystified as to what, by whom, and to what purpose. As he tries to find evidence that can reveal what is going on, the Red agents make their final preparations for the day on which Marty is to do their will and Hunter is to die.

episodes:55394.name: The Hit
episodes:55394.summary: James Hunter is tailing professional hitman G. L. Bassett. During a chase, Bassett is killed in a car accident. Hunter then assumes the identity of the hired killer and meets with the client, Arthur Hillman. However, during their meeting on the beach, both men are shot. Who wants whom dead?

episodes:55394.name: The K Group (Part Two)
episodes:55394.summary: Jim Hunter suddenly finds himself in a wary alliance with Victor, the ruthless East German spy who is the one man in the world for whom Hunter bears an implacable hatred.

show:the shed.name: The Shed
show:the shed.summary: Meet the First Family of Mississippi Barbecue, the Orrisons. Their wildly popular barbecue joint's earned them fame, fortune, devoted fans and a lot of big toys. But no matter how big their business grows, the boisterous, fun-loving clan insists on running the business as a family. Add in all the colorful employees and regulars and it's obvious: This down-home joint is a real-life sitcom.

episodes:24756.name: Do You Take This Hog...
episodes:24756.summary: Brad enlists the Shed's catering services for a friend's wedding and things spiral out of hand. The bride requests the Shed cook a whole hog for the reception, which takes four days but she needs it finished in less than two.

episodes:24756.name: Marketing Geniuses
episodes:24756.summary: When Mama Shed's misfired marketing idea leads to an unplanned ribs giveaway, Brad decides he can do a better job. Brooke disagrees, and challenges Brad and Daddy-O to a guys versus girls Shed marketing contest.

episodes:24756.name: Welcome to the Shed
episodes:24756.summary: The wild summer rush is in full swing at Miss.'s hottest barbecue joint, so it's up to Brad, Brooke and Mama Shed to hire new help. The job interviews are unique, including on-stage auditions and a visit with Shed Pimps.

episodes:24756.name: Something's Fishy
episodes:24756.summary: It's adventure in the Gulf, when Brooke books a catering job aboard a fishing boat for friends visiting from New Zealand. Brad has other business ideas and sets up a Shed pulled pork sandwich concession with Hobson on the beach.

episodes:24756.name: One Smokin' Taxi
episodes:24756.summary: Brad seeks to expand the enterprises. So, he takes a job creating a barbecue smoker out of a Checker cab for a taxi company. Coal Miner decides to take a vacation. So, he hangs around The Shed in his customized "vacation chair."

episodes:24756.name: Barbecue Battle
episodes:24756.summary: Brad and The Shed crew hit the road to Virginia for the Smoke on the Mountain barbecue competition. But it's trouble right from the start, when problems during transit may force them to withdraw from the whole hog competition.

show:confessional.name: Confessional
show:confessional.summary: The series follows a rouge terrorist turned Soviet assassin, code named Cuchulain, trying to prevent a peace agreement between the parties involved in Northern Ireland.

show:barbarians.name: Barbarians
show:barbarians.summary: Who were the warriors who battled the Romans and spread terror throughout Europe? Watch as The History Channel tells the gripping story of some of the most brutal men in history: the Vikings, the Goths, the Mongols, and the Huns.
